Hybrid working patterns depending on the host country policies. Collaboration across different countries, functions, and time zones. Travel may be required depending on business needs.

Hybrid working environment depending on local policies. Collaboration with local business teams and relevant regional or global stakeholders. Occasional travel may be required depending on business needs.

Territory \& Prospecting Strategy

SaaS Solution Framing  

Negotiation \& Closing Skills

description:
**Job Description:**


We are looking for a skilled HR manager to oversee all aspects of Human Resources practices and processes. You will support business needs and ensure the proper implementation of company strategy and objectives. The goal is to promote corporate values and enable business success through human resources management, including job design, recruitment, performance management, training \& development, employment cycle changes, talent management, and facilities management services.


Responsibilities:

* Enhances the organization's human resources by planning, implementing, and evaluating employee relations and human resources policies, programs, and practices.
* Maintains the work structure by updating job requirements and job descriptions for all positions.
* Supports organization staff by establishing and interviewing program; counselling managers on candidate selection; conducting and analyzing exit interviews; and recommending changes.
* Prepares employees for assignments by establishing and conducting orientation and training programs.

title: Senior HR Business Partner
description:
The Senior HR Business Partner has overall responsibility for assisting with HR strategy, planning and execution for select client organizations within Wolters Kluwer’s Digital Experience Group (DXG). This role supports Human Resources Shared Services processes and policies and works in a collaborative fashion with the HR Shared Services Centers of Excellence including Employee Relations, Compensation, Benefits, Talent Acquisition, and Talent Development in addition to Country/regional HR Market leaders, HR Support, and local HR Operations teams across EMEA and APAC regions. It is critical that the Human Resources Associate Director balance both the business strategy and the HR strategy in a global, matrix environment.


The DXG division of Wolters Kluwer co\-creates state\-of\-the\-art digital solutions with our businesses around the world. The DXG mandate is to grow revenue in the company’s digital products through innovation in, and adoption of, advanced technologies and tools to meet and further anticipate customer needs. The group drives innovation in Wolters Kluwer through its user experience center of excellence, focused on customer\-centric product development, and its artificial intelligence center of excellence, applying cutting\-edge technologies for the next generation of expert solutions.


Key responsibilities include:

* Work with the VP, HR Business Partners to assist in executing the HR strategy that supports select client organizations within DXG and their respective internal customers.
* Be an effective business consultant and talent SME, engaging in the work that matters most to the success of the business and establishing clear plans and success measures.
* Develop “trusted advisor” relationships with key business partners and ensure effective communication with leadership.
* In partnership with HR colleagues in COEs and Operations, assist with providing subject matter expertise for key human resources programs including Performance Management, Talent Management, Employee Relations, Organizational Development, Employee Engagement, Organizational Design, and Change Management. Ensure the successful execution of these programs within the assigned business, leveraging available tools and resources.
* Accountable for organization development and effectiveness for the assigned business. Engaging CoE partners as appropriate, responsible to diagnose, identify scope of change, and identify interventions needed to improve organizational effectiveness. Assist with design of future state changes (people, process, and structure), supporting change plans and working with employees to implement.
* Support managers on people and organizational matters, and the HR/talent implications of business decisions.
* Stay abreast of industry best practices, identifying areas of improvement and recommending and/or implementing those best practices to support the corporate goals.
* Act as a globally minded change agent and role model.
* Support managers to consistently upgrade talent by developing and implementing processes specifically related to assessing and managing talent, by taking a leadership role in recruiting and staffing, by coaching leaders and overseeing performance improvement, and by providing support for appropriate actions.
* Pro\-actively assess the level of the organization’s employee engagement and define/drive the strategy to increase the level of employee engagement.
* Collaborate with peers, Shared Services, Compensation, Benefits, Staffing, Organizational Development, and country HRBP \& support teams to establish related priorities for the business.
* Provide HR coaching to assigned leaders to achieve business results.
* Implement HR policies and practices in the business, consistent with corporate guidelines.

* Bachelor's degree, PHR preferred.
* Minimum of 12\+ years of HR Generalist experience with a solid expertise in change management, project management and shared services experience balancing multiple stakeholder relationships.
* Excellent judgment and decision\-making skills with the ability to navigate ambiguity and provide leadership to drive solutions
* Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence management, while maintaining strong relationships.
* Effective at leading change and organizing people and activities to achieve successful outcomes
* Demonstrated ability to collaboratively work with a wide range of people at all levels of the organization

description:
Job Overview
  
  

**Role Profile :** SAP Technical \& Platform Lead
  
Role
  
The SAP Technical \& Platform Lead will serve as the hands\-on engineering and operational leader for Osttra’s SAP implementation. This role is responsible for the end\-to\-end operational lifecycle, system connectivity, and technical management of the SAP platform, while also overseeing the broader corporate technology suite including Dayforce (HCM). Based in Gurugram, the position ensures that internal transactional architectures are highly stable, automated, and seamlessly integrated with upstream and downstream boundary applications.
  
This is an execution\-focused, infrastructure\-aware engineering leadership role. The successful candidate will blend strategic vendor coordination with deep SAP platform expertise, directly managing a small, agile local team of 4–5 engineering professionals covering both SAP and Dayforce platforms, alongside overseeing third\-party Application Management Services (AMS) vendor support.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
Team Leadership \& Vendor Governance
  
* Team Direction: Direct, coach, and mentor a core local team of 4–5 technical professionals in India covering the SAP and Dayforce platforms, translating global roadmaps into executable daily sprints.
* AMS Vendor Accountability: Manage day\-to\-day delivery and hold Application Management Services (AMS) partners and third\-party vendors strictly accountable to contractually agreed technical SLAs.
* SAP RISE Coordination: Manage daily interactions with SAP's cloud teams regarding the SAP RISE hosted managed cloud environment, coordinating infrastructure administration, routine patching, and logging Service Requests (SRs).


Platform Management
  
* Service Management: Directly responsible for day to day IT Service Management \- ensuring there is a proactive and robust process for managing incidents, problems and change.
* Connectivity Management: Own and manage the overall technical boundaries, system connectivity, and network infrastructure remaining directly in Osttra's control.
* Environment Control: Maintain the health, security, and access controls of non\-production integration and testing environments to ensure zero disruption to live operations.


Integration, Middleware \& Data Integrity
  
* Middleware Architecture: Oversee data mapping, file transfer (FTP) capabilities, and secure data flows between SAP and peripheral applications utilizing the SAP Integration Suite (SIS).
* Ledger Boundary Control: Secure and optimize automated data ingestion points and APIs on the financial ledger side where upstream transactional or billing data enters the accounting environment.
* Bespoke Cloud Support: Monitor and maintain external integration utilities, such as the Java\-based Vertex SAP Integration Component (SIC) hosted on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) virtual machines.


Technical Governance \& Defect Resolution
  
* Advanced Troubleshooting: Act as the ultimate technical escalation point for complex platform defects, utilizing deep database and coding insights to resolve issues standard vendor or AMS support cannot easily fix.
* Data Optimization: Apply architectural understanding of SAP to actively optimize system queries and code objects.
* Compliance Guardrails: Ensure all technical configurations, security permissions, and master data structures strictly align with global data privacy frameworks (e.g., GDPR for HR data) and internal financial controls.


Required Skills \& Qualifications
  
Technical Expertise
  
Core SAP Platform \& Infrastructure (Required)
  
* Vendor \& AMS Management: Proven experience managing third\-party enterprise application vendors and AMS providers, specifically coordinating infrastructure administration within an SAP RISE or equivalent managed cloud environment.
* Automation Engineering: Demonstrated experience building automated system monitoring frameworks, alert triggers, and ticketing system integrations (e.g., Jira).
* Database \& Development Mechanics: Solid technical familiarity with the HANA database environment and the ability to read or modify SAP code objects (e.g., ABAP) to fix critical sorting or performance defects.


Cloud \& Middleware Specializations (Good to Have)
  
* SAP Integration Suite (SIS): Understanding of SIS middleware architecture, data mapping rules, and file transfer (FTP) integrations.
* Cloud Infrastructure (GCP): Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) virtual machine environments and hosting parameters for Java\-based integration components.
* Dayforce and Human Capital Management (HCM): Familiarity of Dayforce or other HCM systems


Professional Experience \& Competencies
  
* Leadership \& Team Building: Proven track record of managing and optimizing a small technical team (4–5 people) handling multi\-platform corporate environments (ERP/HCM).
* Execution Track Record: Proven background translating technical corporate requirements into stable, live, hands\-on infrastructure and software solutions.
* Clear Communication: Strong capability to bridge the gap between third\-party cloud engineers, internal developers, and non\-technical business stakeholders (CFO, Head of HR).


What Success Looks Like (12–18 Months)
  
* Platform Stabilization \& Visibility (6 Months): Successfully establish automated alerting and Jira monitoring configurations across the SAP landscape, minimizing manual status checks and improving incident response times.
* Resource \& Support Alignment (12 Months): Fully optimize the workflow between the internal 4–5 person team and the external AMS vendor, achieving high user satisfaction scores regarding the stability and response times of the SAP and Dayforce platforms.
* Operational Velocity (Ongoing): Deliver all ongoing platform changes, network adjustments, and structural system updates with a low disruption rate to core global operations


**Our benefits include:**  

* Health \& Wellness: Health care coverage designed for the mind and body.
* Flexible Downtime: Generous time off helps keep you energized for your time on.
* Continuous Learning: Access a wealth of resources to grow your career and learn valuable new skills.
* Invest in Your Future: Secure your financial future through competitive pay, retirement planning, a continuing education program with a company\-matched student loan contribution, and financial wellness programs.
* Family Friendly Perks: It’s not just about you. OSTTRA has perks for your partners and little ones, too, with some
* best\-in class benefits for families.


About OSTTRA
  
  

Launched in 2021, OSTTRA unites four businesses that have been at the heart of post\-trade evolution and innovation for over 20 years: MarkitServ, Traiana, TriOptima and Reset.
  
With an outstanding track record of developing and supporting critical market infrastructure, our combined network connects thousands of market participants to streamline end to end workflows – from trade capture at the point of execution, through portfolio optimisation, to clearing and settlement.
  
Joining the OSTTRA team is a unique opportunity to help build a bold new business with an outstanding heritage in financial technology, playing a central role in supporting global financial markets. Learn more at www.osttra.com.

title: Human Resources Coordinator
description:
We are looking for HR Coordinators who can act as the face of the organization throughout the candidate journey. At CynLr, we believe alignment begins before a person joins, not after. The first interaction a candidate has with us shapes how they understand the company, the role, and the founder’s intent. In this role, you will do the heavy lifting of translating that intent into clear, thoughtful, and compelling communication across every stage of hiring and onboarding.
 



**About the Role** 




 As an HR Coordinator, your primary contribution will be to shape how candidates experience CynLr from the moment they discover an opportunity to the moment they join. You will support hiring teams in carrying the organization’s impression in an insightful, consistent, and high\-context manner. This role combines recruitment coordination, employer branding, stakeholder communication, process discipline, and early\-stage organizational alignment.
 



**What You Will Do** 




 • Applicant stage: Adapt job descriptions to the requirements and audience of each platform, including LinkedIn, the company website, and other relevant channels, to improve discoverability and attractiveness. Research candidate demographics, skill combinations, and platform behavior to determine where and when to publish roles for maximum relevance.
 



 • Campus recruitment: Support high\-coordination campus hiring efforts where the objective is not volume but identifying the right candidate in a difficult market. Help manage large applicant pools, communication flows, institution coordination, and branding touchpoints across campuses.
 



 • Candidate stage: Send and coordinate emails for tests and interviews, share preparation details, ensure support team availability, maintain test records and reports, and contribute to the design of filtering criteria using available assessment data.
 



 • Selected candidate stage: Manage candidate confirmations, coordinate interview logistics with relevant stakeholders, maintain interview performance records, and ensure timely follow\-up communication for all candidates who participate in the process.
 



 • Onboarding stage: Log new joiner details into internal systems, generate employee IDs, coordinate with IT for asset issuance, collect required documents, and administer internal and statutory induction programs.
 



 • Employer impression and communication: Act as a consistent and professional point of contact for candidates, helping remove communication roadblocks and ensuring that the organization’s values, expectations, and founder’s impression are carried meaningfully throughout the journey.
 



**Job Requirements** 




 • Domain and tool knowledge: Understanding of business operations, communication fundamentals, HR operations, employer branding, and negotiation. Familiarity with major job portals, applicant tracking systems, payroll software, and strong working knowledge of MS Office tools.
 



 • Core skills: Strong organization, documentation, and coordination skills, with the ability to interface effectively with external stakeholders. Excellent professional communication and negotiation skills, an understanding of human psychology, and the ability to manage expectations with maturity and clarity.
 



 • Behavioral tendencies: Critical thinking, responsibility, versatility, resourcefulness, availability, thoroughness, and strong attention to detail.
 



**What Success Looks Like** 




 • Roles are clearly defined, market\-informed, and aligned with the company’s stage and business needs.
 



 • Hiring processes are structured, candidate\-centric, and continuously improving through data and feedback.
 



 • Strong talent pipelines are built across experienced hiring, campus hiring, and institutional partnerships.
 



 • Employer messaging resonates with the right candidates across different talent segments and platforms.
 



 • Cross\-functional hiring teams are supported with clarity, responsiveness, and strategic insight.
 



**Who We Are Looking For** 




 • You are deeply curious and prefer understanding the problem before applying templates or assumptions.
 



 • You are action\-oriented and enjoy building, coordinating, and improving systems rather than only advising on them.
 



 • You think analytically and can connect business context, talent strategy, and market behavior.
 



 • You communicate clearly and can work effectively across founders, hiring managers, HR teams, branding teams, and operations stakeholders.
 



 • You are excited by startup environments where roles evolve quickly and thoughtful hiring can create outsized impact.
 



**Who You Will Work With** 




 You will work closely with the HR and Talent Management team for execution. You will also collaborate extensively with Branding and Tech teams to shape role narratives and hiring journeys, and partner with Operations and Finance teams where planning and budget considerations are involved.
 



**How Your Career Progresses** 




 We see this role as the starting point of a long\-term journey into Human Resources Management at CynLr. In a startup environment, the company evolves quickly and the needs of the organization expand continuously. Over time, this role can open pathways into specialized areas within HR, including talent acquisition, people operations, employer branding, onboarding, and broader organizational development.
 



**Why Join Us** 




 If you are excited by the idea of building hiring systems that are strategic, analytical, and deeply human, this role offers the chance to shape how a company discovers and develops talent from the ground up. You will help define not just who we hire, but how we think about roles, talent markets, candidate journeys, and long\-term organizational growth.

title: Co-Founder and Medical Doctor (MBBS)
description:
About Mednevo

Mednevo is an early\-stage AI healthcare startup revolutionizing \*primary healthcare\* in India. We combine \*cutting\-edge AI technology\* with a genuine patient\-first approach to deliver accessible, personalized, and high\-quality care. Our platform integrates \*on\-demand virtual consultations, in\-home doctor visits, proactive wellness monitoring, and AI\-powered tools for interactive consultations, patient education, and personalized health insights.

We are particularly focused on making quality care — including pediatric care — more efficient, affordable, and scalable across urban and semi\-urban India. As a small, high\-impact team (2\-10 people), we move fast and solve real problems: reducing wait times, supporting clinical decisions with AI, improving outcomes for families and children, and building the future of intelligent healthcare delivery.

The Opportunity We are looking for a passionate Medical Doctor to join as a Co\-Founder. This is not a traditional clinical job — it is a founding leadership role where you will shape the clinical vision, build the product alongside AI engineers, and help scale a mission\-driven healthcare ecosystem. You will bring real\-world medical expertise (especially in pediatrics) to ensure our AI tools are clinically accurate, safe, empathetic, and truly useful for Indian families and doctors.

Key Responsibilities **⁠ ⁠**

**Clinical Leadership \& Product Vision: Co\-define the medical strategy and clinical pathways, with special focus on pediatric care, primary health, preventive wellness, and common childhood conditions.** ⁠ ⁠AI \+ Medicine Integration: Work closely with AI engineers to train, validate, and refine AI models for symptom assessment, triage, personalized advice, and decision support. Provide clinical oversight to ensure safety and accuracy. **⁠ ⁠**

**Patient Care Excellence: Lead or supervise virtual consultations and in\-home visits (initially hands\-on, later more strategic). Help design workflows that blend human empathy with AI efficiency.** ⁠ ⁠Product Development: Collaborate on building user\-friendly tools for doctors, patients, and parents — including pediatric growth tracking, vaccination reminders, developmental screening, and family health management. **⁠ ⁠**

**Regulatory \& Quality: Ensure compliance with healthcare regulations, data privacy (HIPAA\-like standards), and medical ethics in India.** ⁠ ⁠Growth \& Ecosystem Building: Support fundraising, partnerships with hospitals/clinics, go\-to\-market strategy, and expansion of our AI\-hospital ecosystem. Represent Mednevo at medical conferences and among the doctor community.

**⁠ ⁠Team \& Culture: Help build a high\-trust, innovative team culture that attracts top medical and tech talent. What We’re Looking For** ⁠ ⁠Medical Qualification: MBBS from a recognized institution (mandatory). MD/DNB Pediatrics (pursuing or completed) is a strong advantage. **⁠ ⁠**

**Experience: 0\-2 years post\-MBBS (including internships or residency). Fresh graduates or final\-year MD candidates with strong academic records and genuine interest in technology are encouraged to apply.** ⁠ ⁠Passion for AI \& Innovation: Curiosity or experience in digital health, telemedicine, or AI applications in medicine. No prior tech experience required — we value clinical insight and willingness to learn. **⁠** 

**⁠Pediatric Interest: Strong preference for candidates with exposure to or deep interest in pediatrics — child health, neonatology, developmental pediatrics, or family medicine.** ⁠ ⁠Founder Mindset: Entrepreneurial spirit, ownership attitude, resilience, and excitement about building something from the ground up. Ability to wear multiple hats in a fast\-paced startup. **⁠ ⁠Skills: Excellent communication (especially with patients/parents), empathy, basic tech\-savviness, and comfort working in a remote/hybrid setup.** ⁠ ⁠Location: Open to candidates in Tamil Nadu, Kerala, or willing to relocate/base in Chennai/Thiruvananthapuram. What We Offer

**⁠ ⁠Significant Equity: As a Co\-Founder, you will receive meaningful ownership in the company — your impact will directly translate into long\-term rewards.** ⁠ ⁠Competitive Compensation: Stipend during the early phase, transitioning to market\-competitive pay as we grow and secure funding. **⁠ ⁠**

**Learning \& Impact: Direct mentorship from the Founder \& CEO. Opportunity to shape AI tools that can impact thousands of patients, especially children and families.** ⁠ ⁠Flexible Work: Remote\-first with support for in\-person clinical or team activities. **⁠ ⁠**

**Growth: Be part of a mission\-driven team at the intersection of AI, pediatrics, and healthcare innovation in one of India’s fastest\-growing sectors. If you are a doctor who dreams of using your medical knowledge to build the next generation of intelligent healthcare — rather than just practicing in the traditional system — this is your chance to become a true Co\-Founder. We review applications on a rolling basis and respond to shortlisted candidates quickly.** 

**Mednevo – Making healthcare smarter, kinder, and more accessible for every Indian family.**

title: Vertiv - Penetration Tester ( 0-0 yrs )
description:
**Job Description**
 Job Description
   

  

 Join a High\-Performance Culture That Drives Innovation and Excellence
   

  

 At Vertiv, we don’t just hire talent—we cultivate leaders who drive innovation and engage teams to push the limits of what’s possible. As a global leader in critical digital infrastructure, we are scaling up to meet the demands of AI, data centers, and next\-gen technology—and we need bold, high\-performing individuals like YOU to take us to the next level.
   

  

 Why Vertiv?
   

  

* High\-Performance Culture: We empower you to think big, execute with excellence, and deliver impact. Our performance\-driven mindset rewards those who challenge the status quo and drive meaningful change. Over 50 CEO Awards are given annually to recognize top talent moving the needle forward.
* Leadership Without Limits: Leadership at Vertiv goes beyond just titles—it’s about accountability, trust, and ownership. Our leaders engage and drive with collaboration, innovation, and customer\-centric thinking, setting the foundation for an action\-focused culture.
* Limitless Growth \& Learning: We believe in continuous development. Whether through rotational programs or high\-impact projects, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your expertise and grow your career.
* A Place for Everyone: Our commitment to inclusion ensures that all employee’s unique strengths and perspectives are valued. Your voice matters, your growth is prioritized, and your success is celebrated.


 Role Overview
   

  

 The Analyst II \| Application and Product Security is responsible for conducting security pen testing, monitoring, and auditing within a dynamic global organization. The products under test will have the coverage of embedded devices and cloud services. The Senior Pen Tester should have exposure to embedded devices as well as cloud services (AWS/Azure). Some of the products will be white box tests while others will be total black box engagements. A successful Senior Pen Tester will be able to take the product and evaluate the weak points in the design and implementation and focus in on those weaknesses to find security gaps. All the findings by the Senior Pen Tester will need to be clearly documented and relayed to the design team for mitigation. The Senior Pen Tester will need to be very versatile in their attack vectors and their knowledge of exploits. The ideal candidate will be well experienced in a broad range of attack vectors across a wide spectrum of devices from small, embedded devices to wide and complex cloud ecosystems.
   

  

 They will be responsible for interfacing with engineering teams to conduct security testing, auditing and should be able to explain the findings. They will be responsible for ensuring that engineering teams stay in compliance with the security expectations of the global organization. The Senior Pen Tester will be expected to stay current with the latest security threats and attack vectors that can be deployed against the product portfolio. They should also have experience in communicating clearly and concisely the findings of these activities to an audience.
   

  

 The testing activity and methodology deployed to confirm compliance is guided but expected to be enhanced by the Senior Pen Tester. The Senior Pen Tester will be expected to use their knowledge and experience to further develop internal testing processes and procedures.
   

  

 Job Responsibilities
   

  

**Duties**
 In addition to performing internal application and product security assessments the Analyst II \| Application and Product Security will be expected to support response to possible breaches of security based on newly disclosed information. Other key duties include:
   

  

* Conduct security evaluation and threat assessments of embedded systems, mobile applications, web applications
* Conduct research for the purposes of finding new vulnerabilities and enhancing existing capabilities
* Circumventing security protection methods and techniques
* Performing data bus monitoring (snooping) and data injection
* Conduct communications protocol analysis in the embedded products, and applications
* Conduct wireless communications channel snooping, and data injection
* Reverse engineering complex systems and protocols
* Create detailed technical reports and proof of concept code to document findings
* Perform System Breakdown of the project/product before testing, identify and evaluate all the testing requirements and plan out the detailed testing activities, resources etc.
* Proactive detailed interaction with respective engineering group on the testing needs, testing progress/status and provide detailed analysis report
* Have effective Gitlab issue management reviewing and, providing mentorship and direction on planned testing activities for junior resources in line with defined processes and procedures. Assist in leading testing activities in all the regions, provide head\-to\-head support to Assessment Pillar Manager and help to drive continuous improvement in testing processes and procedures.
* Thorough adherence and follow\-up of VERTIV SECURE requirements and Vulnerability Management and Incident Response processes.
* Preference given to other practical skills such as functional analysis, memory image capture, static memory analysis, and data element extraction, etc.


 Job Requirements
   

  

* A bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science or related Engineering field is highly desirable.
* Additional advanced security qualifications such as CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional) certification, Offensive Security Web Expert (OSWE) or equivalent preferred.
* Three or more years’ experience in information, application, and embedded product security and/or IT risk management with a focus on security, performance, and reliability
* Solid understanding of security protocols, cryptography, authentication, authorization, and security
* Good working knowledge of current IT risks and experience implementing security solutions
* Ability to interact with a broad cross\-section of personnel to articulate and enforce security measures
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills as well as business acumen
* Strong leadership, vision, effective communication and goal\-oriented
* Strong ability to establish partnerships and influence change and achieve results within dynamic environment
* Meaningful technical contributions into the development lifecycle of an application, product, or service


**Preferred Knowledge Experience Includes**
* Understanding and development experience of embedded systems / software, and web\-based applications
* Linux network device driver/data\-path performance exposure
* Familiarity with compilers, debuggers, disassemblers, and other low\-level development and analysis tools
* Exposure to binary analysis tools such as IDA Pro, WinDbg, BinWalk, Valgrind, PIN, Panda, and S2E
* Working knowledge of hacking tools and techniques such as memory corruption exploits, rootkits, protocol poisoning, browser\-based attacks, DNS poisoning, MetaSploit, nmap, Nessus, etc.
* Experience with UNIX kernel internals and low\-level Windows internals
* Comfort with reading and understanding of x86 and/or ARM assembly
* Experience with program analysis techniques such as taint analysis, program slicing, symbolic execution, constraint solving, and dynamic instrumentation
* An understanding of common cryptographic algorithms and protocols including their weaknesses and attacks against them
* Ability to extract software/firmware from provided hardware
* Meaningful experience utilizing git (Github or gitlab)
* Understanding of network protocols and experience developing packet\-level programs
* Experience with common microcontroller programming tools and debugging interfaces
* Linux network device driver/data\-path performance exposure
* Exposure to Layer 2, Layer 3 networking, QoS
* Network and/or application security knowledge (L2/L3 firewall, DPI, IDS, IPS)
* Knowledge of common malware/botnet exploits and how they are targeted to exploit embedded systems
* Operating system configuration of Windows, Linux, Android, and iOS
* Computer boot process including boot loaders
* Conducting security evaluation and threat assessments of embedded systems, mobile applications, web applications
* An understanding of common cryptographic algorithms and protocols including their weaknesses and attacks against them
* Familiarity with compilers, debuggers, disassemblers, and other low\-level development and analysis tools
* Having hands on real\-time embedded C/C\+\+ development experience that includes recent lab activities integrating with and debugging on target hardware.

Headquartered in Kansas City, USA, C2FO has more than 500 employees worldwide, with operations throughout North America, Europe, India, Asia Pacific, and Australia. C2FO is the world’s largest on\-demand working capital platform. Our mission is to ensure every business has the capital needed to thrive and we have delivered more than $400\+ billion in funding to businesses since our founding. How do we do this? By providing fast, flexible, and equitable access to low\-cost capital through our easy\-to\-use platform.We provide technology with a human touch, giving our customers the direct support they need and ensuring our team members have the tools, resources, and work environment they need to deliver on our promise to customers. With the C2FO platform, businesses worldwide have more working capital to fuel their growth, create jobs and develop new products.

That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package, flexible work options for work/life balance, volunteer time off, and more. Learn more about our benefits here. Empowered by the flexibility of cloud\-based hosted computing, and spread across India and US, collectively, these teams are responsible for leveraging both internal and external data that helps C2FO innovate, take data backed decisions, and solve complex business problems such as customer acquisition and retention.

title: HR Executive
description:
RaK's Pallikkoodam subscribes to the 21st century learning principles and is a student\-centered, future\-focused, coeducational day school. Creativity and Critical thinking, combined with developing the strength of character is at the core of our programme. The school is also grounded in the 21st\-century educational principles.

For more information, please visit https://www.rakspallikkoodam.com

***DESCRIPTION***

We are seeking an experienced, empathetic, and highly organized **HR Executive** to carry out our human resources functions. Unlike a corporate environment, an international school thrives on a community\-centric culture where empathy, patience, and relationship\-building are just as important as policy enforcement.

In this role, you will handle the entire employee lifecycle—from attracting top\-tier global educators to handling complex payroll, compliance, and employee grievances. To succeed, you must be a champion of confidential data management, possess exceptional English communication skills, and understand the fluid, event\-driven calendar of an educational institution.

***KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:***

* **End\-to\-End Recruitment \& Onboarding:** Handle the full talent acquisition cycle for academic, administrative, and support staff. This includes sourcing international and local educators, conducting background and reference checks, managing visa/work permit processes, and designing welcoming orientation programs.
* **Policy Formulation \& Implementation:** Update and implement school HR policies, staff handbooks, and codes of conduct. Ensure all policies align with local labor laws, international educational standards, and child safeguarding protocols.
* **Payroll \& Benefits Administration:** Handle monthly payroll processing, tax deductions, social security, health insurance, and end\-of\-service benefits with zero margin for error.
* **PF \& ESI:** Deep understanding of statutory compliance regarding PF and ESI, with proven expertise in handling registrations, monthly contributions, and documentation directly through the official portals.
* **Employee Relations \& Grievance Handling:** Act as the primary point of contact for staff grievances, conflicts, and personal queries. Mediate issues with high emotional intelligence, escalate it to the respective Leads / HODs / HOS and ensuring fair resolutions while maintaining a harmonious school climate.
* **Data Management \& HRIS:** Maintain meticulous, up\-to\-date physical and digital employee records (contracts, performance reviews, credentials). Fully manage the school’s HRIS (Human Resources Information System) to ensure data accuracy and generate insightful HR reports.
* **Confidentiality \& Compliance:** Handle sensitive information—such as salary structures, legal disputes, performance issues, and medical records—with the utmost discretion and integrity.

***REQUIRED QUALIFICATION \& EXPERIENCE:***

* **3 to 5 years of progressive HR experience, with a minimum of 2 years specifically within an international school setting is mandatory.** (Experience navigating expatriate teacher recruitment and visa regulations is highly preferred).
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
* **Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.**
* **Must have atleast 2 years of experience in statutory compliance regarding PF, ESI and navigating their portals.**
* Hands\-on experience working with HRIS software and payroll systems.
* Exceptional organizational skills for maintaining foolproof soft and hard copy filing systems.
* Strong understanding of local labor laws and employment regulations governing educational institutions.

***CULTURAL FIT \& WORKING ATTRIBUTES:***

* A deep understanding that a school environment requires an approachable, flexible, sensitive and nurturing HR presence rather than a rigid, corporate corporate approach.
* Ability to adapt to the school calendar. This includes preparing for peak hiring seasons (usually prior to the new academic year) and being flexible with working hours during major school events, orientations, or parent\-teacher weeks.
* The ability to remain calm, objective, and supportive under pressure while dealing with sensitive personal or professional staff issues.

Applicants **without relevant qualification and experience** are requested **NOT TO APPLY** and will not be considered. **Freshers** are requested **NOT to apply.** The candidates are requested **NOT TO CALL THE SCHOOL.**

As a Video Content Creator, you will become one of the faces of FunnelKit’s content ecosystem. You will create software tutorials, product demonstrations, YouTube educational videos, advertisements, Reels, and Shorts that educate, engage, and inspire our audience.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Stay updated with content creation trends, YouTube best practices, and video presentation techniques.
* Continuously improve communication, presentation, and storytelling skills.

**What We're Looking For**

**Required Qualifications**

* Excellent spoken and written English.
* Strong confidence and comfort appearing on camera regularly.
* Clear communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to explain software products and concepts in a simple and engaging way.
* Comfortable recording screen\-sharing tutorials while speaking.

* Must have a reliable internet connection and the ability to record high\-quality audio and video from home.

**Preferred Qualifications**

**Recording Setup Requirements**

To be successful in this role, candidates should have access to:

* A high\-quality smartphone camera or dedicated camera capable of recording professional\-looking videos.

* Good lighting setup (natural light or artificial lighting).

title: System Administrator
description:
**About CynLr** 




  





 Just like a baby’s brain, CynLr Visual Intelligence stack makes Robots to
 **instinctively see \& pick any object under any ambience, without any training. Demo Video** 




 Today, a robot that can fit a screw into a nut without slipping a thread, doesn’t exist. Imagine what it would take for a robot to
 **assemble a Smartphone** 
 or a car by putting together 1000s of parts with varied shapes and weights, all in random orientations. Thus, factories become complex, needing heavy customization of their environment.
 



 CynLr\-enabled visual robots intuitively learn to handle even unknown objects, on\-the\-fly, eliminating the need for rigid fixtures, pre\-training, or environment customization. This enables an universal alternative to custom automation thus simplifying factory lines into modular LEGO\-like micro\-factories that can be rapidly reconfigured as products change.
 



 At the core of CynLr lies a fundamentally new approach to machine vision. Unlike conventional vision systems that rely on image recognition and heuristics, CynLr’ s Vision and ML stacks are deeply inspired by neuroscience, modelling how biological vision understands shape, geometry, and interaction rather than appearance alone. To support this, CynLr builds its hardware, sensors, compute pipelines, and learning stacks from scratch, tightly coupling perception, decision\-making, and action.
 



 This integration allows CynLr to operate in conditions that defeat traditional automation: variable lighting, cluttered environments, unknown objects, and high precision manipulation, unlocking automation use cases that have remained unsolved for decades. By rethinking vision as an intelligent, adaptive sense rather than a static tool, CynLr is redefining how robots perceive, reason, and interact with the physical world.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




  





 As a
 *System Administrator at CynLr* 
 , you will design, build, and evolve IT infrastructure, processes, and practices that support research, product development, and operations, while ensuring efficient, secure, and sustainable usage. Process for the sake of process will not be entertained;
 *utility and convenience take precedence, and every system must justify its existence by improving real outcomes.* 





  





 CynLr's ambition demands not only breakthrough algorithms and hardware, but also a
 *robust, adaptive, and human\-centric IT infrastructure* 
 that allows teams to operate with minimal friction and maximum focus. As CynLr scales across disciplines, tools, and geographies,
 *IT infrastructure becomes the information backbone of the organization.* 
 The goal of this role is not merely uptime or compliance, but to
 *augment human productivity* 
 , eliminate hidden delays and context\-switching costs, and ensure that technology remains an enabler rather than a constraint.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





***A. Operate***




  




* Run and maintain IT infrastructure supporting research, engineering, and operations at scale.
* Administer the Office 365 ecosystem (SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, identity and access).
* Operate and secure endpoint devices across Windows, Android, BYOD, and corporate assets.
* Manage network infrastructure including routers, switches, firewalls, Wi\-Fi, and VPNs.
* Perform hands\-on monitoring, troubleshooting, and incident resolution across hardware, OS, network, and applications.



  





***B. Build***




  




* Design and deploy Azure AD, Intune, and SharePoint policies for secure and organized access.
* Set up and maintain hardware infrastructure—laptops, workstations, servers, networking, and conferencing systems.
* Configure and support Windows Server, Linux, virtualization platforms (VMware / Hyper\-V).
* Establish remote workflows and inter\-office connectivity to enable distributed teams.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with hardware, software, and service vendors.



  





***C. Improve***



* Automate workflows and remediation using PowerShell scripting to reduce manual effort.
* Evaluate and select hardware and software based on supportability, ecosystem maturity, scalability, and lifecycle cost.
* Proactively monitor systems, analyse failures, and implement preventive and reliability improvements.
* Continuously refine IT processes and practices to remove friction and improve user productivity.



  





**Team Structure:** 



* The Operations team at CynLr functions as a
 *cross\-functional enablement layer* 
 that supports Engineering, Product, and Business teams in executing reliably and at scale. Within this structure, Technology and Systems responsibilities are owned as a core operational capability, ensuring that digital infrastructure, tools, and access evolve in step with how the organization works.
* Systems and IT operations are designed to be
 *deeply integrated into day\-to\-day execution* 
 , preserving context across teams and workflows. The function works closely with Engineering to support research and development needs, and with Operations and Finance to ensure reliability, security, and long\-term sustainability.



  





**What You’ll Need to Do This Well** 



* Strong understanding of computer hardware and workstations: CPU, memory, storage, BIOS/firmware and
 *how configuration choices impact developer productivity and system reliability.*
* Deep familiarity with
 *office productivity and collaboration systems,* 
 and the ability to
 *design workflows that reduce friction and context switching* 
 rather than add process overhead.
* Solid grounding in
 *networking fundamentals* 
 (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, firewalls) relevant to office, lab, and inter\-office environments.
* Clear understanding of
 *device configuration, identity management, and user access policies, balancing usability with security.*
* Working knowledge of
 *security principles, data protection, and basic database concepts,* 
 sufficient to design safe and scalable internal systems.



  





**Experience That Will Accelerate You** 



* Hands\-on experience with
 *DevOps or internal tooling infrastructure* 
 , especially in environments where tooling is still evolving.
* Experience setting up and maintaining databases or data services used internally by teams.
* Exposure to building IT systems in
 *fast\-moving, resource\-constrained environments where requirements change frequently.*
* *Experience supporting engineering\-heavy teams* 
 , including compute\-intensive workflows, development environments, and high\-performance workstations

 *digital infrastructure that enables CynLr’s teams to work without friction* 
 . Your role is to ensure that systems, tools, and access models support how people actually work across research, engineering, operations, and business functions.

 *translate organizational needs into reliable, secure, and intuitive IT systems, spanning devices, networks, collaboration tools, identity, and internal workflows* 
 . From onboarding a new team member to supporting compute\-heavy engineering setups, your work ensures that infrastructure never becomes the bottleneck to progress.

 *systems\-first, entrepreneurial approach* 
 , suited to a deep\-tech environment where requirements evolve rapidly and standard enterprise playbooks often fall short.

title: Project Manager - EPMO
description:
**Who are we?**

 We appreciate that our most important asset is our people. We offer a fun, friendly work environment and a culture that values honesty and respect. We have a strong sense of team. We genuinely appreciate each individual but recognise the collective when achieving success.
   

  

 We are committed to creating a flexible work environment for our people by supporting them to balance their work commitments and personal needs, both now and into the future.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities** 
**What next?**
 As a growing business we’re looking for likeminded people to join us \- we hope that’s you.
   

  

* Lead allocated EPMO projects — Tier 1 (Explore), Tier 2 (Build) or Tier 3 (Transform) — based on experience and demonstrated capability. This includes development and execution of scope, schedule, budget, resource, risk, change, communications and stakeholder management plans, applied proportionate to project tier and complexity.
* Apply consistent project management principles across all allocated projects, working within the EPMO’s flexible delivery framework and adhering to its intake, scoring, governance, reporting and closeout standards.
* For Tier 2 initiatives, partner with the nominated business sponsor to develop and refine concise business cases, ensuring scope, rationale, cost, effort and expected return on investment are clearly articulated and aligned with EPMO scoring criteria.
* For Tier 3 initiatives, deliver under the strategic oversight of the EPMO Director, ensuring full governance is observed and that the named ELT sponsor is appropriately engaged throughout the project lifecycle.
* Contribute to the EPMO’s benefits realisation framework — capturing baseline measures at planning, tracking realised benefits through delivery, and providing inputs to the EPMO’s ROI and outcomes reporting back to ELT.
* Maintain accurate, current project records in the EPMO portfolio dashboard, including status, resourcing, risks, issues, dependencies, scope changes and benefits\-tracking data.
* Facilitate the requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, training and change management activities required for successful project delivery, working collaboratively with subject matter experts and vendors.
* Identify and escalate emerging risks, scope changes or threshold breaches (effort, cost, dependency) that may trigger tier escalation, in line with the EPMO operating model.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including IT, Technology and Innovation, Quality and Compliance, Finance, Clinical Operations and Senior Management to negotiate resource commitments and ensure on\-time delivery of projects.
* Manage external vendors associated with project deliverables, ensuring scope, schedule and contractual obligations are met.
* Provide regular project status updates and portfolio inputs to the EPMO Director, and contribute to monthly ELT portfolio reporting packs.

+ Tier 1 (Explore): early\-career project management experience or relevant transferable experience supporting small, single\-team initiatives.
+ Tier 2 (Build): a minimum of 3 years managing cross\-functional internal projects with named sponsors and defined business cases.
+ Tier 3 (Transform): a minimum of 5 years managing strategic, multi\-stream or transformation projects with executive\-level reporting and accountability for benefits delivery.
+ Experience contributing to benefits realisation, ROI measurement or outcomes reporting frameworks is highly desirable.
+ Experience managing technology, systems integration, ERP, CRM or business process transformation projects will be highly regarded given Avance’s current strategic roadmap.
+ Strong working knowledge of established project management methodologies (waterfall, agile and hybrid) and the judgment to apply them proportionate to project size and complexity.
+ What we offer
- Stimulating work
- Project diversity
- An intellectual challenge
- An agile \& flexible workplace
- Opportunity to progress
- Stability
- Sense of community
- A leadership team that are working together on a common goal
- Flexible work options
- Great tools / tech to do your job
- A competitive salary

title: Technical Program Manager
description:
**Role Summary** 


 Earnifi is seeking a Technical Program Manager (TPM) to drive execution across multiple engineering and technical initiatives in a fast\-moving fintech environment. This role will partner closely with Engineering, Product, Data, Underwriting and integration partner teams to ensure projects are planned, coordinated, and delivered successfully.
 





 The TPM will help bring structure, visibility, and accountability to complex initiatives while maintaining the agility required in a growing startup. The ideal candidate is highly organized, technically curious, comfortable working through ambiguity, and capable of managing multiple concurrent projects without introducing unnecessary process or bureaucracy.
 





 This role is well\-suited for someone who enjoys solving problems, coordinating stakeholders, and helping teams execute effectively in an environment where priorities evolve and new challenges emerge regularly.
 



**Responsibilities** 
**Program \& Project Delivery** 
* Lead execution of multiple concurrent technical projects and initiatives from planning through delivery.
* Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, milestones, dependencies, and status reporting.
* Coordinate activities across internal and external partner teams
* Track deliverables, risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies across active projects.
* Facilitate project meetings, status reviews, and stakeholder communications.
* Proactively identify execution risks and drive resolution before they impact delivery.


**Cross\-Functional Coordination** 
* Serve as a central point of coordination across technical and business teams.
* Ensure alignment between project objectives, priorities, and delivery commitments.
* Coordinate activities involving external vendors, technology partners, and service providers as needed.
* Facilitate communication between technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Escalate issues and blockers appropriately to maintain project momentum.


**Process \& Operational Excellence** 
* Introduce lightweight processes and tools that improve visibility, accountability, and execution.
* Support planning activities, roadmap coordination, and delivery forecasting.
* Maintain project documentation, decision logs, and reporting artifacts.
* Help establish repeatable delivery practices appropriate for a scaling startup environment.
* Contribute to continuous improvement efforts across engineering and technical operations.


**Compliance \& Risk Management** 
* Coordinate technical initiatives involving security, compliance, audit, regulatory, or operational requirements.
* Ensure key stakeholders are engaged throughout project lifecycles.
* Track remediation efforts, control implementation activities, and compliance\-related deliverables.
* Support audit readiness and documentation efforts as required.


**Qualifications** 
**Required** 
* 3–6 years of experience in technical program management, project management, engineering operations, product operations, consulting, or related roles.
* Experience coordinating multiple concurrent projects involving cross\-functional teams.
* Strong organizational, planning, and stakeholder management skills.
* Familiarity with software development lifecycles and Agile delivery practices.
* Experience using project management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, Linear, Asana, or similar platforms.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced environment with evolving priorities.
* Demonstrated ability to create structure and drive execution in environments with limited formal processes.


**Preferred** 
* Experience in fintech, payments, banking, payroll, or other regulated industries.
* Experience coordinating initiatives involving security, compliance, audit, or regulatory requirements.
* Familiarity with software development, APIs, cloud platforms, data systems, or modern software architectures.
* Experience working with distributed or remote engineering teams.
* Technical background in engineering, computer science, information systems, or a related discipline.


**Success Metrics** 
* Successful delivery of technical projects and initiatives.
* Improved visibility into project status, risks, dependencies, and commitments.
* Reduction in project delays caused by coordination or dependency issues.
* Increased predictability of delivery timelines and outcomes.
* Effective coordination across technical and business stakeholders.
* Positive stakeholder feedback from Engineering, Product, Compliance, and Operations teams.


**What Success Looks Like** 
* Creates enough structure to improve execution without slowing teams down.
* Keeps multiple projects moving forward simultaneously in a dynamic environment.
* Identifies risks, dependencies, and blockers early and drives resolution.
* Adapts quickly to changing priorities while maintaining focus on key deliverables.
* Enables teams to execute more effectively through coordination, communication, and accountability.
* Helps Earnifi scale its operational maturity while maintaining startup speed and flexibility.

**Job Posting Title**: Unabot AI Assistant Manager

**Location:** UniOps Bangalore

**About Unilever:**


Be part of the world’s most successful, purpose\-led business. Work with brands that are well\-loved around the world, that improve the lives of our consumers and the communities around us. We promote innovation, big and small, to make our business win and grow; and we believe in business as a force for good. Unleash your curiosity, challenge ideas and disrupt processes; use your energy to make this happen. Our brilliant business leaders and colleagues provide mentorship and inspiration, so you can be at your best. Every day, nine out of ten Indian households use our products to feel good, look good and get more out of life – giving us a unique opportunity to build a brighter future.


Every individual here can bring their purpose to life through their work. Join us and you’ll be surrounded by inspiring leaders and supportive peers. Among them, you’ll channel your purpose, bring fresh ideas to the table, and simply be you. As you work to make a real impact on the business and the world, we’ll work to help you become a better you.

**PURPOSE OF THE ROLE**


As part of the Employee Technology Organisation, the **Unabot AI Assistant Manager** plays a pivotal role in ensuring the optimal use, governance, and continuous enhancement of Unilever’s AI‑powered digital assistant platform (Una).


The role focuses on **maximising business value from AI‑driven self‑service**, ensuring that knowledge, insights, and conversational experiences are accurate, relevant, trusted, and continuously improved.


Working closely with the Unabot AI Product Owner, the role partners with multiple business functions (HR, IT, Supplier Ops) to ensure the full functional capability of the AI chatbot platform is realised, adoption is driven at scale, and enhancements are aligned to evolving employee needs and AI advancements. **Vendor management** is a good to have exposure.


The role also requires staying current with **AI, conversational AI, and generative AI enhancements** introduced by platform providers and translating these into tangible business outcomes.

**WHAT WILL YOUR MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES BE**

* Partner with the **Unabot AI Product Owner** to deliver new and innovative AI‑driven solutions on the chatbot platform, aligned to business requirements and employee experience outcomes.
* Work closely with senior stakeholders across business functions and supplier partners to design, prioritise, and deliver **AI‑enabled self‑service capabilities** and knowledge experiences.
* Ensure the service provider delivers services in line with agreed scope, service level agreements (SLAs), and contractual obligations, with specific focus on **AI response quality, accuracy, and reliability**.
* Maintain a strong understanding of **knowledge management principles**, including how structured and unstructured knowledge is consumed by AI systems.
* Participate in and contribute to the **governance framework for AI‑enabled knowledge management**, including policies, standards, ethical use of AI, and definition of key performance indicators (e.g. deflection, accuracy, sentiment, containment).
* Support incident reduction and increased self‑service deflection by continuously improving **AI answer quality, knowledge relevance, and conversational flows**.
* Establish and maintain governance with functions and markets to ensure knowledge content is **AI‑ready, well‑structured, and continuously optimised** for chatbot consumption.
* Drive continuous improvement across the knowledge lifecycle using **user sentiment, analytics, AI performance metrics, and feedback loops**.
* Perform periodic knowledge and AI performance audits to identify gaps, risks, and improvement opportunities.
* Develop and maintain training and enablement materials (including guides and videos) to help business users, contributors, and stakeholders understand **how to work effectively with AI‑powered tools**.
* Actively drive best practices and adoption of AI‑enabled self‑service across the organisation.
* Own and deliver **insights and reporting** related to chatbot usage, AI performance, knowledge effectiveness, and user experience.
* Collaborate effectively with cross‑functional stakeholders, demonstrating strong communication skills to translate **AI and technical concepts into business‑friendly language**.

**EXPERIENCE \& QUALIFICATIONS**

**Essential**

* Language: English (fluent)
* 5 years of IT experience, ideally in a global or regional role
* Strong customer‑ and service‑centric mindset
* Ability to work under pressure and navigate ambiguity
* Experience working with diverse, cross‑functional, vendor management and technical teams
* Ability to adapt quickly and learn new technologies and ways of working
* Strong networking, influencing, and stakeholder management skills
* Passion for continuous improvement and service excellence
* High level of self‑motivation and accountability

**AI‑Related Experience (Essential / Strongly Preferred)**

* Hands‑on experience working with **AI‑powered platforms**, chatbots, or digital assistants (e.g. conversational AI, virtual agents, self‑service tools).
* Good understanding of **how AI models consume, retrieve, summarise, and present knowledge**.
* Experience analysing **AI performance metrics** such as accuracy, containment, deflection, sentiment, and feedback signals.
* Ability to identify AI response gaps, hallucinations, or quality issues and work with technical teams and vendors to remediate them.
* Awareness of **responsible AI principles**, including data quality, bias, transparency, and employee trust.

**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE \& QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience managing IT service providers, knowledge management services, and external suppliers
* Good understanding of service management and governance processes
* Experience working with data, analytics, or insights platforms
* Appreciation of IT infrastructure and enterprise application landscapes
* Experience working with **ServiceNow** or similar service management tools
* Experience creating and maintaining **Power BI dashboards** or similar analytics solutions
* Exposure to **generative AI capabilities** (e.g. summarisation, search relevance, prompt‑based interactions) is an advantage

**SKILLS**

* IT Service Management / ITIL
* Agile Delivery
* Knowledge \& User Search
* Stakeholder Management
* Vendor Management
* Analytical Thinking
* Data \& Insight Analysis
* Project Management
* Effective Communication
* Microsoft Power BI
* Product \& Experience Improvement

description:

 At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.
   

  

 Today, we are part of Booking Holdings \[NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.
   

  

 No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.
   

  

**Get To Know Our Team:**
 The People Team is a purveyor of opportunity, searching the globe for the most talented individuals and offering them an open, collaborative workplace. By prioritizing skill and potential, we have cultivated a powerful assembly of professionals through our drive for equal opportunity and diversity. We make the move to Agoda a breeze with assisted onboarding programs, and we continue to support and enrich our thousands of Agoda employees through individual growth with outstanding learning programs and various means of assistance. Our development of incredible benefits has ensured everyone can stay strong, healthy, and happy during their time at Agoda. Leading ambitious changes and making a positive impact in the lives of our employees, the People Team is a crucial and rewarding part of the Agoda family.
   

  

**The Opportunity:**
 We are looking for someone to lead our Global Employee Relations Team as a Senior Manager, Employee Relations. This role leads the development of policies, advisory standards, case governance and analytics to ensure fair, consistent and legally sound people practices. The incumbent partners closely with HR leadership, Legal, unions, and government agencies to manage complex disciplinary matters, labor relations issues and emerging workforce risks.
   

  

 The role combines deep industrial relationships expertise, policy leadership, stakeholder influence, and data\-driven decision making, and serves as a subject\-matter authority on employment legislation and industrial relations strategy.
   

  

 Our Employee Relations consultants work closely with key stakeholders including our Legal/Compliance team, Corporate Tax, Corporate Governance, Talent Business Partner team and the Senior Management Team to support employees in challenging circumstances, and we seek to identify trends and share insights to adjust our people management practices to get the best talent outcomes. We advise and enable managers to make the best possible decisions, challenging practices that go beyond legal obligation to protect our unique culture at Agoda.
   

  

**What You’ll Do:**
* Elevate Compliance and Policy Expertise: Act as the go\-to specialist on ER Matters, guiding managers in adhering to company policies, local laws, and regulations. Establish governance standards, operating guidelines and decision frameworks to ensure consistency across the organization. Translate employment legislation, case law and regulatory changes into clear institutional policies and guidance.
* Enhance Manager Effectiveness: Lead the design, review and implementation and advise people managers on the Organization\-wide employee \& labor relations and HR policy framework. Critically evaluate systemic issues in manager capability and practices and escalate them appropriately to business leaders for sustainable resolution.
* Union Engagement: Represent the organization in union consultations, negotiations, arbitration and dispute resolution forums. Analyze union and management proposals to assess policy, financial and employee\-relations implications. Support collective bargaining strategies through data, benchmarking and scenario analysis.
* Streamline Disciplinary and Termination Processes: Ensure accurate execution and documentation of disciplinary actions and terminations to minimize labor disputes.
* Lead Investigations and Employee Relations processes: Conduct impartial investigations into grievances and serve as a dedicated Employee Relations partner, identifying trends and insights to inform procedural improvements.
* Drive Performance and Policy Enhancements through Analytics: Analyze performance management data and past misconduct cases to develop recommendations for capability\-building, policy revisions, training enhancements, and more effective management practices.
* Optimize Performance Management and Offboarding: Spearhead improvements in performance management systems and refine offboarding processes, incorporating data from different sources to enhance employee experiences.
* Regulatory \& Dispute Management: Liaise with Legal team to represent and manage the Company in negotiations, arbitrations and dispute resolution forums or other regulatory authorities.


**Required Qualifications:**
* Deep understanding of employee relations, labor relations and workplace dispute management.
* Strong working knowledge of employment legislation, regulations and industrial relations practices.
* Ability to interpret legislation and apply it practically within complex organizational environments.
* Advanced stakeholder management and influencing capability across senior leaders, unions and regulators.
* Strong negotiation, mediation and conflict\-resolution skills.
* Ability to balance organizational risk with empathy and sound judgement.
* Degree in Human Resource Management, Law, Industrial Relations, or related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* A minimum of 13 years in Employee and Labor Relations or HR Business Partnering roles within large or regulated organizations, with a proven track record of handling complex employee relations issues.
* Extensive knowledge of employment laws and regulations in the relevant region, with the ability to interpret and apply them in various scenarios.
* Hands\-on experience managing and executing restructuring/change management projects
* Strong analytical and critical thinking skills
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders
* Ability to cope well with ambiguity and change
* High level of discretion, confidentiality, and ethical standards in handling sensitive information and situations.

* Proficiency in using data and analytics to inform decision\-making processes and improve employee relations strategies.
* Fluency in written and spoken English, with strong communication skills to effectively convey complex information.
* Demonstrated leadership qualities and a desire to take on managerial responsibilities in the future.


**Preferred Qualifications:**

**4\. Employee Engagement \& Culture**

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**Role:** 
 HR Head with 3\-5 years' HR experience, to manage people operations across design studio (\~20 people) and packaging manufacturing facility (\~45 people). 100% role, on\-site. Please note that this is a newly created role. You will be the first and only dedicated HR professional across Z\&B and SCPL, building people processes from the ground up. There are no current plans to expand the HR function.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




 Short\-term (1\-2 years):
 


* Serve as the single point of accountability for all people operations across Zinc \& Broccoli and sister company SCPL: hiring, exits, performance, engagement, and HR administration
* Own the KRA/KPI framework and performance review cycle: conduct structured periodic 1:1s and formal appraisals across both organisations, and ensure all reviews are documented
* Run end\-to\-end hiring processes: JD creation, job posting, screening, interview coordination, offer management, and onboarding for all roles across Z\&B and SCPL
* Facilitate exit processes: resignation handling, notice period management, offboarding checklists, and exit interviews
* Act as a buffer between management and day\-to\-day staff issues: handle employee concerns, interpersonal conflicts, and policy queries independently, reducing management overhead
* Establish and administer POSH compliance: set up an Internal Committee, ensure all employees across Z\&B and SCPL are trained and aware of the policy, and serve as the first point of contact for any complaints or concerns



  





**Medium to long\-term (2\-3 years):** 



* Build and maintain active candidate pipelines for recurring roles, reducing time\-to\-hire
* Drive training and upskilling cadence across teams: coordinate with management to identify gaps and organise learning programmes
* Develop deeper engagement initiatives, team building activities, and culture\-building programmes suited to both a design studio and a production environment
* Potential to shape HR policy and organisational design as both companies grow



  





**Key Result Areas (KRAs)** 




 The following are the results that we would like to have across both organisations, as a result of bringing you on board. These will be key criteria in deciding your growth path and future promotions.
 


* Measurable reduction in management time spent on routine HR tasks and people issues
* Consistent, well\-documented hiring and exit processes across Z\&B and SCPL
* Timely, accurate performance review cycles completed on schedule
* Improvement in employee engagement and retention
* Clean HR records and full compliance with Z\&B and SCPL policies



 Further goals and objectives, KPIs, and project plans will be discussed in detail during the interview process and onboarding. 
 



  





**Basic terms of employment:** 



* Permanent, full\-time, on\-site role with Zinc \& Broccoli at our Kanakapura Road office
* 6 months' probation (no paid leaves during probation)
* 2 months' notice period if employee wishes to terminate the contract



  





**Skills and tools required:** 



* 3 to 5 years of HR experience, with at least 1\-2 years in a generalist or HR lead role
* Prior exposure to diverse work environments: professional services, creative studios, or structured production settings is an advantage
* Experience in owning performance management and KPI tracking
* Strong English communication skills, written and verbal; verbal proficiency in Kannada is a necessary
* Proficiency in Microsoft Outlook, Excel is mandatory; experience with HRMS tools such as PagarBook or similar is a plus
* Ability to handle sensitive employee matters with discretion and maturity
* Organised, process\-driven, and capable of working independently with minimal hand\-holding



  





**About Zinc \& Broccoli** 




 Zinc \& Broccoli is a communication design studio specialising in B2B marketing communications for manufacturing and technology companies. Our strength lies in translating complex technical concepts into visually compelling and easy\-to\-understand marketing materials. We work with clients globally who value strategic design thinking and collaborative partnerships. Learn more at www.zandb.in
 



  





 SCPL is a Bengaluru\-based printing and production company, part of the same founding group. It operates a full\-service print and packaging production facility with a workforce across production staff, machine operators, supervisors, and management staff. Learn more at www.scpl.net
 



  





**Working at Z\&B** 




 We're a small, senior\-led team where ownership is real and access to leadership is direct. We work on demanding briefs for global clients, move fast, and hold ourselves to a high standard. If you're looking for a role where your work visibly shapes the organisation, this is it.
