**Job Description**
**Jubilant Bhartia Group**
 Jubilant Bhartia Group is a global conglomerate founded by Mr. Shyam S Bhartia and Mr. Hari S Bhartia with strong presence in diverse sectors like Pharmaceuticals, Contract Research and Development Services, Proprietary Novel Drugs, Life Science Ingredients, Agri Products, Performance Polymers, Food Service (QSR), Food, Auto, Consulting in Aerospace and Oilfield Services. Jubilant Bhartia Group has four flagships Companies\- Jubilant Pharmova Limited, Jubilant Ingrevia Limited, Jubilant FoodWorks Limited and Jubilant Industries Limited. Currently the group has a global workforce of around 46,000 employees.
   

  

**About Jubilant Ingrevia Limited**
***JubilantIngreviaisnowamemberoftheeliteGlobalLighthouseNetwork(GLN) oftheWorldEconomicForum(WEF)***
 Jubilant Ingrevia history goes back to 1978 with the incorporation of VAM Organics Limited, which later became Jubilant Organosys and then Jubilant Life Sciences and now demerged to an independent entity as Jubilant Ingrevia Limited, which is listed in both the stock exchanges of India. Over the years, company has developed global capacities and leadership in chosen business segments.
   

  

 Ingrevia is born out of a union of ‘Ingredients’ and ‘Life’ (‘Vie’ in French). Jubilant Ingrevia Limited is committed to offering high\-quality and innovative life science ingredients to enrich all forms of life.
   

  

 Jubilant Ingrevia, a global integrated Life Science products and Innovative Solutions provider serving, Pharmaceutical, Nutrition, Agrochemical, Consumer and Industrial customers with our customised products and solutions that are innovative, cost\-effective and conforming to excellent quality standards.
   

  

 Jubilant Ingrevia Limited offers a broad portfolio of high\-quality ingredients that find application in a wide range of industries. Jubilant Ingrevia’s portfolio also extends to custom development and manufacturing for pharmaceutical and agrochemical customers on an exclusive basis.
   

  

 Ourbusinessissplitacross3businessverticals,withgloballeadership acrossourkeyproductlines.
   

  

***Speciality Chemicals:***
 The Specialty Chemical business of Jubilant Ingrevia manufactures Pyridine, Picolines and its forward integration derivatives, which finds application in agrochemicals, pharmaceuticals, dyes, solvents, metal finishes, fine chemicals, semiconductors etc.
   

  

 We have also launched new platform of Diketene \& its value\-added derivatives for multiple industry use. We are an established ‘partner of choice’ in CDMO, with more investment plans in GMP \& Non\-GMP multi\-product facilities for Pharma, Agro and Semi\-conductor customers.
   

  

***Chemical Intermediates:***
 The Chemical Intermediates business has acetic anhydride and value added anhydrides and aldehydes catering to various industries.
   

  

***Nutrition \& Health Solutions:***
 The Nutrition \& Heath Solutions business unit offers B3 \& Picolinates (Chromium \& Zinc) which are fully backward integrated. Our ingredients find application in animal nutrition, human nutrition, personal care, etc. We provide high\-quality feed \& food additives having application in poultry, dairy, aqua \& pet food industry. In Human Nutrition \& Health Solutions, we offer food ingredients \& premix solutions to nutrition.
   

  

 Jubilant Ingrevia Limited is supported by five state\-of\-the\-art manufacturing facilities in India. We practice world\-class manufacturing processes in our day\-to\-day operations, assuring our customers with unmatched quality and timely delivery of products through innovations and cutting\-edge technology. Transforming Manufacturing for Operational Excellence \& Sustainability with “zero tolerance to any non\-compliance” is the core focus of Jubilant Ingrevia Manufacturing.
   

  

 We have 5 world\-class manufacturing facilities i.e. One in UP at Gajraula, Two in Gujarat at Bharuch and Savli, Two in Maharashtra at Nira and Ambernath.
   

  

***Environment Sustainability***
 The company is committed to environmental sustainability and supports green chemistry by prioritising the use of bio inputs in manufacturing. Jubilant is one of the world’s largest producers of Acetaldehyde from the bio route.
   

  

 Find out more about us at www.jubilantingrevia.com

title: Head, People & Culture
description:
**ABOUT RIGHTWALK** 





 RightWalk Foundation is a public policy implementation and state\-capacity building organisation. We exist to ensure that progressive public policies actually work for people at scale — not just on paper, but in real lives, over time. Our RIGHT model — Redesign, Institutionalize, Ground, Hone, Transition — converts policy intent into sustained government\-owned outcomes. We operate across 4 states, have impacted 2M\+ lives and unlocked $2\.2Bn\+ in public funds.
 




  






 ROLE PURPOSE
 





 RightWalk is building a Mission Mode \+ Structured Discipline \+ Earned Flexibility culture — and culture is not managed by decree. The Head – People \& Culture will be the institutional architect of how people experience RightWalk: how they are hired, onboarded, developed, evaluated,recognised, and when necessary, exited. With an HR Manager now in place handling operations, this role is the strategic layer above
 





 — owning organisational design, performance culture, leadership development, and the values infrastructure that makes iHERO real in daily work. This is a builder role: most systems don't yet exist at the standard we need.
 




  






 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 





 1\. People strategy and organisation design
 





 • Own RightWalk's people strategy — talent acquisition, retention, development, and succession planning — aligned to the organisation's growth
 





 • Support role clarity, reporting lines, spans of control and hiring prioritisation.
 





 • Partner with leadership to prevent structure from becoming decorative furniture.
 





 • Manage the HR Manager's work and provide strategic direction — ensure HR operations are reliable and professional.
 





 2\. Performance and accountability systems
 





 • Design and implement a performance management system that is fair, consistent, and genuinely used — not a box\-ticking exercise.
 





 • Strengthen OKRs, performance reviews, feedback systems and role scorecards.
 





 • Partner with the Director – Founder's Office and MD (when hired) on OKR cascades, performance reviews, and leadership team health.
 





 • Ensure managers are trained to review performance fairly and consistently.
 





 • Build a culture where accountability is not confused with personal attack.
 





 • Support state and field HR needs — ensure that PMU and GDN hiring is systematic, ethical, and values\-aligned.
 





 3\. Leadership development and manager capability
 





 • Design manager training, leadership coaching and capability\-building systems.
 





 • Support senior and middle managers to lead teams, give feedback and manage conflict.
 





 • Build second\-line leadership depth across HQ and states.
 





 • Build the organisation's learning and development architecture — onboarding programmes, role\- specific training, leadership development for senior staff.
 





 Culture and employee experience
 





 • Own culture stewardship — translate RightWalk's values (iHERO) into observable behaviours, recognition systems, and accountability mechanisms.
 





 • Support onboarding, town halls, team rituals and internal communication.
 





 • Build employee experience touchpoints: town halls, feedback mechanisms, grievance redressal, and wellbeing systems.
 





 • Address burnout, conflict, disengagement and misalignment with maturity.
 





 5\. HR governance and policy
 





 • Oversee HR Manager and ensure recruitment, onboarding, leave, contracts, documentation and 
 





 compliance are clean.
 





 • Review HR policies, grievance mechanisms, POSH, disciplinary processes and employee lifecycle 
 





 systems.
 





 • Ensure compliance with all labour laws and HR statutory requirements — in coordination with the Finance \& Compliance function.
 





 • Ensure people decisions are documented, fair and legally sound.
 





 • Design and implement the compensation and benefits framework — ensuring it is competitive within velopment sector and internally equitable.
 





 CANDIDATE PROFILE
 





 • Experience: 12–18 years in HR or OD, with at least 5 years in a strategic or leadership HR role. Prior experience in the development sector, social enterprise, or a mission\-driven organisation is strongly
 





 preferred.
 





 • Builder: Proven ability to build people systems from scratch — not just maintain existing ones.
 





 • OD: Strong OD capability — can diagnose organisational dynamics, design interventions, and facilitate leadership team alignment.
 





 • Culture: Track record of building performance cultures — not just running appraisal cycles, but making accountability real.
 





 • Character: Empathetic but clear — can hold the tension between caring for people and holding high expectations.
 





 • Complexity: Familiarity with multi\-state, multi\-level organisations — including field staff, state teams, and HQ leadership simultaneously.
 





 • Sector: Experience with development sector compensation benchmarking and FCRA/labour law compliance is a plus.

title: HR Assistant II
description:
**Summary:**



 This role involves supporting day\-to\-day operations by maintaining constant communication with site operations, senior leadership, content team, technology teams, and other internal clients on the status of real\-time metrics. The position requires a working knowledge of real\-time monitoring in a call center environment, with a focus on service level (SL), volume metrics, and occupancy management.
 




**Responsibilities:**
* Maintain real\-time monitoring in the call center environment, focusing on SL, volume offered/incoming/handled, outsourcing percentages, and email backlog sizes.
* Write root cause analysis for any service failures.

* Conduct timely discovery and escalation of outages, performing troubleshooting steps to identify affected parties and impact.
* Understand queues/routing profiles and perform skill blending and profile modification as needed.
* Set up Priority Queue (PQ), Visibility Threshold (VT), and Preserve Avail (PA) based on SL and occupancy performance.
* Manage occupancy, including VTO decisions and NPT approvals.
* Manage AUX states/non\-adherence and escalate to corresponding Planning \& Vendor teams.
* Conduct intraday reporting, including call\-outs.
* Review existing SOPs and prepare new SOPs to document learnings from incidents and daily events.
* Display effective communication, capable of summarizing daily performance and handling leadership queries with appropriate RCA.
* Manage user profiles in terms of onboarding, offboarding, access management, and reconciliation.


**Requirements:**
* 6 months of customer service experience.
* 6 months of experience with Microsoft Office products and applications.


**Required Skills:**
* Effective verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to perform root cause analysis and summarize performance metrics.


**Preferred Skills:**
* 1 year of customer service experience.
* 1 year of workforce management (real\-time monitoring) experience in a call center environment.
* 1 year of experience with Microsoft Office products and applications.

description:
**Description**
 This is a contractual role.
   

  

 At Amazon we believe that every day is still day one.

If you’d like to help the Disability Leave Services (DLS) team build a best\-in\-class professional services program to deliver leave of absence, disability and accommodation services to Amazon employees, applicants, job seekers and candidates globally, this is your chance to make history by joining the amazing Disability \& Leave Services Team.
   

  

 The DLS Case Manager provides case management for all types of leave of absence and disability life events. The DLS Case Manager is highly skilled in answering questions, understanding the employee’s situation, applying the appropriate benefits, responding to changing circumstances and needs, and paves the way for a connected and trusted case management experience. * Initiate and respond to inquiries about leave and disability events, benefits, and options available to employees

* Facilitate a smooth return to work and ramp\-back plan for employees returning to the workplace

* Communicate regular updates to employees and stakeholders both verbally and in writing
* Ensure compliance with standard work, federal/state regulations, and company policy
* Maintain system records to ensure accurate and timely information/documentation
* Consult, coordinate and partner with our third party administrator, HR, Safety, Legal, Payroll, Benefits, team members and other departments/systems as appropriate
* Other duties as assigned

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent

title: Data Engineer I, SPIA
description:
**Description**
 Join Amazon’s Selling Partner Insights and Analytics (SPIA) organization as a Data Engineer, where you'll build the data infrastructure powering 200\+ business teams across Amazon Stores. Shape the future of data engineering for a platform processing millions of cases daily, driving insights that directly impact customer experience and operational excellence across the world's largest e\-commerce ecosystem.
   

  

 Paragon is a case management system (CMS) used by 180\+ business teams within Stores to manage their communications and interactions with their customers. These business teams using Paragon are our enterprise customers. Paragon CMS includes: a customizable workbench UI, a lifecycle manager, a routing layer, such as tenant configuration, case storage, security, and data insights and analytic. The successful candidate is expected to contribute to all parts of the data engineering and deployment lifecycle, including design, development, documentation, testing and maintenance. You will thrive in our collaborative environment, working alongside accomplished engineers who value teamwork and technical excellence. We're looking for experienced technical leaders.

* Design/implement automation and manage our massive data infrastructure to scale for the analytics needs of case management.
* Build solutions to achieve BAA(Best At Amazon) standards for system efficiency, IMR efficiency, data availability, consistency \& compliance.
* Enable efficient data exploration, experimentation of large datasets on our data platform and implement data access control mechanisms for stand\-alone datasets

* Interface with other technology teams to extract, transform, and load data from a wide variety of data sources using SQL, Amazon and AWS big data technologies
* Must possess strong verbal and written communication skills, be self\-driven, and deliver high quality results in a fast\-paced environment.
* Drive operational excellence strongly within the team and build automation and mechanisms to reduce operations
* Enjoy working closely with your peers in a group of very smart and talented engineers.

title: Associate Engineer - Data [T500-26928]
description:
**About Officeworks:** 




 Officeworks’ purpose is “we bring big ideas to life at low prices”. We are Australia’s leading omnichannel retailer of complete technology solutions, stationery, furniture, art supplies, and learning resources. We also offer services including Print \& Create and Geeks2U. We begin with customers—our products and services provide solutions to our diverse range of customers across Australia, from households, students, small to large\-sized businesses, governments, and schools.
 



  





**About the Data and Analytics Function:** 




 By joining the Data, Analytics and AI Hub within Officeworks’ Global Capability Centre (GCC), you will play a pivotal role in enabling business growth and performance through insight, intelligence and innovation. You will support executing the strategy and accelerate the shift to a more digital and AI\-native organization. You’ll help build advanced capabilities that sit at the core of how the business understands customers, informs decisions, invests wisely, and delivers measurable value.
 



 The GCC is a critical enabler of Officeworks’ purpose, by providing data\-driven insights, trusted analytics, and scalable AI solutions that empower smarter, faster decision making and support sustainable success.
 



  





 This is a unique opportunity to join as a founding member of a newly established global hub. Early joiners will help shape how data, analytics and AI shape Officeworks, influencing future ways of working, building critical capabilities, and driving the evolution of some of Officeworks’ most important data and intelligence platforms.
 



  





**These roles are best suited for people who enjoy:** 



* Working in data, analytics and AI disciplines, including data engineering, reporting, advanced analytics, machine learning, governance, and insights generation.
* Supporting global initiatives by building scalable, high quality data and AI products.
* Enabling business transformation through insight\-led storytelling, experimentation, and continuous improvement.
* Thriving in an environment where your expertise is valued, your development is intentionally supported, and your work has a visible, meaningful impact on business outcomes.



  





**Why this role exists:** 




 The Associate Engineer (Data) supports the development and maintenance of robust data pipelines by assisting with the ingestion, transformation, and validation of data sets. The role exists to ensure high levels of data quality and operational reliability within the enterprise data platform, helping the Technology function transition toward a democratized, self\-serve analytics model. By supporting more senior engineers in the delivery of Snowflake and SAP\-integrated solutions, this role enables Officeworks to leverage data\-driven insights for improved commercial and customer outcomes.
 



  





**Where you will make a difference:** 




**In this role you will:** 




**Data Pipeline Support:** 



* Support end\-to\-end development, testing, and deployment of data pipelines.
* Assist with data ingestion from various sources, ensuring successful transformation and loading into the enterprise data platform.
* Perform basic debugging and troubleshooting of data workflows to ensure continuity.



  





**Data Quality and Validation:** 



* Execute routine data quality checks to ensure the accuracy and integrity of business\-critical information.
* Validate data outputs against requirements to support reliable reporting and analytics.
* Identify and escalate data anomalies or inconsistencies to senior team members.



  





**Operational Excellence and Improvement:** 



* Contribute to the documentation of data structures, processes, and system configurations to retain institutional knowledge.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement and automation within daily data engineering tasks.
* Actively participate in continuous improvement initiatives to enhance the efficiency of the data engineering hub.



  





**Technical Growth and Alignment:** 



* Develop proficiency in core enterprise tools including Snowflake, dbt, and SAP BTP.
* Support the alignment of data engineering activities with the broader enterprise data strategy and AI initiatives.



  





**Who you will be working with:** 



* Data Engineering Team: Collaborate daily with other Engineers and Technical Associate Managers for guidance and task delivery.
* Quality Analysts: Partner with QA Associate Analysts to ensure data work meets functional requirements and quality standards.
* Internal Stakeholders: Interact with cross\-functional partners to understand data requirements and delivery timelines.



  





**What success looks like:** 



* Reliable Delivery: Data pipelines and ingestion tasks are completed on time and meet defined technical specifications.
* Data Integrity: High standards of data quality are maintained, with minimal errors reaching production environments.
* Continuous Improvement: Proactive identification of improvement or automation opportunities.
* Capability Growth: Demonstrated progression in technical mastery of Snowflake, dbt, and associated cloud technologies.



  





**How you will lead:** 




**Individual Contributor:** 



* Lives our Officeworks values and behaviours
* Proactively contributes to a safe working environment, escalates appropriately if there are unsafe conditions or inappropriate behaviour
* Operates in line with applicable Officeworks company policies and Code of Conduct
* Demonstrates a strong sense of personal accountability and curiosity to learn and develop



  





**Qualifications and work experience:** 




**Essential:** 



* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related field.
* Experience: 1–2 years of experience in a data\-related or technical support role, or a strong internship background in data engineering.
* Technical Knowledge: Basic understanding of data warehousing concepts, ETL/ELT processes, and SQL.
* Tooling Awareness: Exposure to or fundamental knowledge of cloud data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, AWS, or GCP).
* Adaptability: Proven ability to learn new technologies quickly and adapt to changing project requirements.
* Communication: Clear verbal and written communication skills suitable for a professional corporate environment.



  





**Preferred:**

title: Associate - SOC
description:
**About River**
 River is a design company building multi\-utility products.
   

  

 Our flagship product River Indie, \#SUVofScooters, is designed to help you get things done. Engineered to be a dependable ally on your road to success.
   

  

 We’re a 1000\+ team headquartered in Bengaluru – backed by marquee international investors, with mobility\-focused funds linked to Yamaha Motors, Al\-Futtaim Automotive Group, Toyota VC, Trucks Venture Capital, Mitsui \& Co. Ltd, Marubeni Ventures Inc., Lowercarbon Capital, and Maniv Mobility.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Monitor both SIEM dashboards and the CrowdStrike Falcon console to detect potential security incidents, distinguishing between normal network noise and genuine threats
* Utilize CrowdStrike’s Process Execution Trees to trace the root cause of alerts, analyzing parent/child process relationships (e.g., "Why did Excel spawn PowerShell?") to identify malicious behavior.
* Apply CCNA\-level knowledge of the OSI Model and TCP/IP to correlate endpoint alerts with network logs, verifying if compromised hosts are communicating with Command \& Control (C2\) servers
* Move beyond simple signature matching by using Indicators of Attack (IOAs) to spot "Living off the Land" attacks (fileless malware) and mapping them to the MITRE ATT\&CK framework
* Act as the first responder for security alerts, classifying incidents based on severity and following the NIST Incident Response Lifecycle (Detection \& Analysis) to escalate verified threats
* Assist in cross\-referencing CVEs with CrowdStrike Spotlight data and apply CEH knowledge to understand how attackers might exploit unpatched vulnerabilities in the wild
* Analyze network packet headers (understanding the TCP 3\-Way Handshake and flags) to identify anomalies like SYN floods or port scanning
* Document investigation findings clearly in ticketing systems, detailing the "Who, What, When, and How" of the incident for senior analysts


**Ideal Candidate**
* B.E. / B.Tech / M.Tech in Information Technology, Computer Science, or Cybersecurity.
* Mandatory : CCNA (Strong Network Foundation) \& CompTIA Security\+ (Security Core)
* Fresher with active CEH (Certified Ethical Hacker) or CrowdStrike Certified Falcon Administrator (CCFA)
* Conceptual understanding of EDR (Endpoint Detection \& Response) vs. Legacy Antivirus, and the benefits of cloud\-native, lightweight agents
* Deep understanding of Stateful vs. Stateless Firewalls, DMZ concepts, and packet filtering logic
* Strong familiarity with the Cyber Kill Chain, SQL Injection, XSS, and Phishing vectors
* Ability to explain the difference between IOCs (hashes, IPs) and IOAs (behaviors), and how to use Real Time Response (RTR) concepts
* Basic understanding of Symmetric/Asymmetric encryption, Hashing (SHA/MD5\), and PKI
* Willingness to work in rotational 24/7 shifts (including nights, weekends, and holidays) to support a continuous monitoring Security Operations Center environment
* Strong analytical thinking, ability to "follow the breadcrumbs" during an investigation, and concise communication skills for incident reporting

**Company Description** 
 DigiFortex is a CREST\-accredited, CERT\-In empaneled, and ISO 27001/42001 certified cybersecurity company delivering end\-to\-end security solutions for modern enterprises worldwide. The company offers services such as advanced penetration testing (VAPT), cloud security, SOC implementation, GRC consulting, data privacy, and AI/LLM security assessments. Its team of certified professionals (including CISSP, CISM, CEH, ISO 27001 LA, CCNA, CIPPE) focuses on uncovering real\-world risks and strengthening cyber resilience across IT, cloud, and AI\-driven environments. DigiFortex serves industries such as BFSI, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, manufacturing, government, telecom, IT/ITES, and startups, helping them address complex regulatory and security requirements. The organization is also a leader in LLM penetration testing and offers a vCISO model for ongoing governance, risk management, and compliance.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Penetration Tester role based in Mumbai. The Penetration Tester will plan and execute vulnerability assessments and penetration tests across web, mobile, network, cloud, and API environments, documenting findings with clear risk and impact analysis. Responsibilities include simulating advanced attack scenarios, supporting red team exercises, and collaborating with internal teams and clients to validate, prioritize, and remediate vulnerabilities. The role involves performing security assessments for traditional IT systems as well as AI/LLM\-based applications where applicable, including testing for issues like data leakage and privilege escalation. The Penetration Tester will also contribute to security reports, support presales or technical discussions when needed, and stay current with evolving threat landscapes, tools, and methodologies.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Strong foundation in Cybersecurity principles, threat modeling, network security, and secure architectures.
* Hands\-on experience in Application Security, including web, mobile, API, and cloud application testing.
* Skills in Red Teaming, adversary simulation, and offensive security methodologies are highly desirable.
* Proficiency in Reverse Engineering and Malware Analysis for understanding exploits, payloads, and defensive gaps.
* Familiarity with security tools and frameworks (e.g., Burp Suite, Nmap, Metasploit, Kali Linux, OWASP) and scripting in languages such as Python or Bash.
* Relevant certifications (e.g., OSCP, OSCE) or equivalent practical experience.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field, or comparable professional experience.
* Ability to communicate complex technical findings clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders and work effectively in a



  





**Company Description** 
 DigiFortex is a CREST\-accredited, CERT\-In empaneled, and ISO 27001/42001 certified cybersecurity company delivering end\-to\-end security solutions for enterprises worldwide. The organization offers a comprehensive portfolio including advanced penetration testing (VAPT), vCISO services, cloud security, data privacy, SOC implementation, GRC consulting, and AI/LLM security assessments. Its certified team (including CISSP, CISM, CEH, ISO 27001 LA, CCNA, CIPPE) focuses on uncovering real\-world risks and building long\-term cyber resilience across IT, cloud, and AI\-driven environments. DigiFortex serves sectors such as BFSI, healthcare, pharma, manufacturing, government, telecom, IT/ITES, and startups, with a strong focus on regulatory compliance and secure digital transformation. The company is also a leader in LLM Penetration Testing, helping organizations secure AI systems against emerging threats while enabling safe and responsible AI adoption.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Penetration Tester role based in Mumbai. The Penetration Tester will plan and execute security assessments for web, mobile, network, cloud, and AI/LLM\-based systems to identify vulnerabilities and real\-world attack paths. Responsibilities include conducting red team exercises, preparing detailed technical reports, documenting proof\-of\-concepts, and presenting findings and remediation guidance to technical and non\-technical stakeholders. The role involves collaborating closely with security architects, developers, and operations teams to validate fixes, improve secure design, and enhance overall security posture. The Penetration Tester will also contribute to threat modeling, tool and script development, and continuous improvement of DigiFortex’s testing methodologies, including participation in advanced and specialized engagements.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Strong foundation in Cybersecurity, including security fundamentals, common attack techniques, security controls, and secure architecture principles.
* Hands\-on expertise in Application Security, including web, mobile, API, cloud, and AI/LLM application testing, as well as secure development best practices.
* Practical experience in Red Teaming, adversary emulation, and advanced threat simulations across on\-premise and cloud environments.
* Proficiency in Reverse Engineering and Malware Analysis to dissect binaries, understand payload behavior, and support incident response or advanced assessments.
* Experience with common penetration testing tools and frameworks (e.g., Burp Suite, Metasploit, Nmap, Kali, OWASP methodologies).
* Relevant certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, CRTP, CEH, eJPT, or equivalent practical experience are highly desirable.
* Strong analytical and documentation skills, with the ability to produce clear reports and communicate complex technical findings

title: Network Engineer
description:
**Make your mark with Thiess**
 As a global business, we are proud to offer diverse and rewarding career opportunities. We are committed to Thiess being a company that supports great people to succeed, develop their careers, and feel supported to reach their highest potential. We offer a safe and inclusive work environment where our employees feel strongly connected to our values and objectives, and where the capability of our people is key to our success.
   

  

 Every day, all around the world, Thiess supports and celebrates our people. We recognise talent and reward transparency. We champion diversity and embrace change.
   

  

 Join us. Hone your skills and develop new ones. Take on big challenges and grow through mentorship, collaboration, and empowerment.
   

  

 Thiess is the place to make things happen
   

  

**Why Thiess?**
 Thiess is built on a proud history of delivering excellence in mining for over 90 years. With a team of 15,000\+ across multiple continents, we blend world\-class talent and cutting\-edge technology to shape a sustainable mining future.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
* Deliver technical expertise and support to Thiess ICT by implementing ICT network solutions.
* Document and Enforce: Assist the ICT Network Team in documenting and implementing network policies and standards to ensure a superior communications environment for the business.
* Maintain Critical Infrastructure: Take direct responsibility for the maintenance and support of critical infrastructure.
* Communicate and Resolve: Handle communication, triage, and resolution of network issues effectively.


**About The Role**
* Drives delivery of work tasks to ensure business goals are achieved
* Supports others in the team to ensure delivery of results and improvements
* Effectively coordinates efforts with stakeholders to achieve results
* Deals effectively with issues, conflict and problems and escalates matters for resolution as required
* Actively supports and champions change initiatives across the business
* Understand critical risks in work area and reassess hazards if changes occur in the work area.
* Familiar with and applies the standards and procedures relevant to job .
* Stop the job if in doubt and fix the problem or warn people of any danger .
* Share knowledge with others and contribute to team discussions and meetings
* Take a lead role within the team in working towards financial goals
* Follow and encourage adherence to business processes relevant to their work
* Demonstrates a broad understanding of Thiess’ functional structure and commercial interests
* Works autonomously and with minimal oversight to complete most work activities
* Provides input and advice to other team members and stakeholders when asked
* Builds rapport and strong working relationships across a diverse group of stakeholders
* Listens and communicates clearly to influence stakeholders (verbally and in writing).
* Actively keeps stakeholders informed of work activities and outcomes
* Maintain a high level of professionalism, integrity, interpersonal and communication skills and present a customer focused attitude in daily operations
* Provide timely and quality support, investigation, response, feedback, escalation, assistance, and resolution to incidents logged by the Thiess Helpdesk to Thiess \& Business Unit Employees
* Proactively review the services being provided to ensure they are fit for purpose, cost effective and performing adequately
* Develop \& maintain relationships with business representatives and key stakeholders
* Work with the relevant ICT team members to develop and maintain;
* ICT Architecture Standards
* ICT Infrastructure Standards
* Identify, develop and maintain other ICT Standards as required.
* Ensure all systems and network services are available when required by the business and are performing as expected
* Provide feedback to clients on the status of faults and services requested
* Maintain security systems to ensure that data security is maximized
* Monitor the systems to identify potential issues and forecast future requirements
* Supervise the installation and maintenance of relevant hardware and software
* Promote a collaborative environment within and across D\&T teams
* Produce and maintain process documentation
* Produce and maintain network policy documentation
* Produce recommendation documents
* Assist procurement needs by obtaining prices and sourcing ICT supplies as directed
* Communicate / share idea / knowledge
* Keep up to date with industry developments and identify appropriate applications and new initiatives as required
* Continually seek ways to improve ICT delivery and services
* Drive a culture of continual improvement in the level and the efficiency of delivery of ICT services
* Monitor developments in ICT technology and make recommendations to management on the adoption of appropriate new technologies
* Report at weekly team meetings on project activities and support tasks
* Provide technical advice and support to ICT Support staff when required
* Provide support \& advise to junior members of the team
* Adopt change management processes and best practices in the implementation of changes to major IT\&T systems
* Ensure that business requirements are considered and catered in all planning activities
* Comprehensive understanding of IP and associated protocols (eg TCP, UDP, RTP, DMVPN etc.)
* Comprehensive understanding of VPN technologies (in both MPLS and Internet contexts)
* Comprehensive understanding of hierarchical network design methodologies and technologies
* Firm understanding of the OSI model.
* Firm knowledge of industry cabling standards and methods
* Working knowledge of Voice over IP
* Comprehensive knowledge of Network Design fundamentals
* Comprehensive knowledge of industry standard routing protocols; specifically, OSPF and BGP
* Working knowledge of Internet registrars
* Expert level knowledge of all wireless standards including spectrum analyzers, surveying tools, Wi\-Fi security, RF
* Expert level knowledge working with and implementing wireless mesh networks (in\-pit or highly mobile mesh experience preferred)
* Demonstrated knowledge of Security concepts 802\.1x and Cisco ISE in a production environment.
* Demonstrated experience troubleshooting wireless and wireless mesh networks.
* Working knowledge of next generation firewall technologies specifically Palo Alto.


**About You**
* 4\-5 years demonstrated experience in the operation and design of enterprise level converged networks.
* 4\-5 years network experience in working with cloud\-based applications.
* To work in 24x7 (rotational or fixed) shifts depending on business needs.
* Provide 24x7 timely and quality L2/L3 network support to Thiess global sites.
* Responsible for working closely with Thiess SD team for any ICT issues.
* Four (4\) years’ experience working with Cisco and Juniper technologies including routers, switches, firewalls, and advanced Wireless.
* Experience working within environments that encompass enterprise level network technologies such as disaster recovery and high availability networks, spanning tree, VoIP, Wireless, content switching and Cloud design.
* Experience of working within a complex ICT server environment at a network level
* Experience with working in an environment that is tracked via an incident management tool.
* Responsible for building competence within the team.
* Proper documentation of all the processes and timely updation.


**What Thiess Can Do For You**
* Help to grow your career, offering diverse and varied opportunities for advancement
* Flexible working arrangements
* World\-class health \& wellbeing programs
* On\-site gymnasium
* A range of corporate discounts, including health insurance (Medibank), travel \& retail products
* Referral bonus program


**About Us**
 Thiess works with clients in Australia, Asia, and the Americas in the dynamic field of open\-cut and underground mining.
   

  

 The pioneering spirit of our founders – the legendary Thiess brothers – is our legacy and inspires our vision to harness the power of people and technology to drive sustainable change.
   

  

 At Thiess, you will have the opportunity to play a part in the global energy transition. We are growing our commodities portfolio to include metals and minerals critical to the energy transition and developing services to enable sustainable mining.
   

  

 We’re creating a culture of curiosity, knowledge\-sharing, and continuous learning – supporting our people to contribute to Thiess’ success and continued growth in sustainable mining.
   

  

 We’ll support you to hone your skills and develop new ones, take on challenges and grow, through mentorship, collaboration, and empowerment. We offer our people ongoing technical training and development opportunities so they can reach their full potential. We also invest in the workforce of the future, with a range of programs for people starting their careers.
   

  

 We recognise the value of an inclusive and diverse workplace through our vision of everyone matters always. We’re focused on creating an inclusive environment to enable our people to bring their best selves to work because they feel safe, included, and empowered.
   

  

 Learn more http://thiess.com/makeyourmark
   

  

 Should you require assistance applying for this opportunity, please contact us at hiring@thiess.com
   

  

**How To Apply**
 This role is an opportunity to take the next step in your career. With our culture of recognition, development, and a stimulating and satisfying work environment, there is no better time to join Thiess.
   

  

 Thiess follows a Pre\-Employment Process for all successful applicants, which includes two employment references, a National Police Check, and a medical assessment. These checks are essential to your application, and your recruiter will support you through the process.
   

  

 Please click the “apply” button to apply for this role.

title: ADCS ENGINEER
description:
**About Us:**




  





 Join a team that is redefining the accessibility of space. Azista space is a transformative force in the global aerospace sector, uniquely positioned at the intersection of indigenous innovation and industrial scalability. Operating India’s first private\-sector satellite mass\-production facility in Ahmedabad, we have bridged the gap between complex engineering and high\-volume manufacturing.
 



  





 As a vertically integrated leader, we provide end\-to\-end solutions from the precision design of satellite buses and advanced payloads to mission management and communication systems. We don’t just build hardware, we are democratizing the final frontier by providing global clientele with the cost\-effective, high\-performance technology needed to power the next generation of orbital missions. At Azista, you won't just be starting a job, you’ll be fuelling the future of space exploration.
 



  





  





**About the Role:**




  





 As a Satellite Attitude Determination \& Control Systems (ADCS) Engineer, you will play a critical role in designing, developing, and validating advanced spacecraft guidance, navigation, and control systems that enable precise satellite operations in orbit.
 



  





 Working alongside multidisciplinary teams of aerospace, avionics, software, and systems engineers, you will contribute to cutting\-edge satellite programs from concept development through testing and mission readiness. This is an excellent opportunity for early\-career engineers passionate about space technology, control systems, orbital mechanics, and autonomous spacecraft operations.
 



  





 At Azista Space, you won’t just build satellites—you’ll help make space more accessible, scalable, and impactful for customers around the world.
 



  





  





**Roles \& Responsibilities:**




  




* Develop and validate Attitude and Orbit Control System (AOCS/ADCS) simulations for satellite missions.
* Design, implement, and optimize spacecraft Guidance, Navigation \& Control (GNC) algorithms for precision attitude determination and control.
* Develop advanced estimation techniques, including Kalman Filters (KF/EKF) and state estimation algorithms.
* Build and validate spacecraft guidance solutions for attitude maneuvering, target acquisition, payload pointing, and mission\-specific operations.
* Develop onboard flight software and embedded control applications using C/C\+\+.
* Create system models and perform simulation\-based verification using MATLAB, Simulink, and Python.
* Execute and support Software\-in\-the\-Loop (SIL) and Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop (HIL) testing activities.
* Analyze performance data, troubleshoot control\-system behavior, and improve algorithm robustness.
* Collaborate with avionics, software, systems, and mission engineering teams throughout the spacecraft development lifecycle.
* Prepare technical reports, test documentation, verification records, and engineering analyses.



  





  





**Required Qualifications \& Skills:**




  




* B.E./B.Tech in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics \& Communication Engineering, or related engineering disciplines OR M.E./M.Tech in Control Systems, Aerospace Engineering, Avionics, or related specializations.
* Strong understanding of Control Theory, System Dynamics, and Feedback Control Systems.
* Proficiency in C, C\+\+, MATLAB, Simulink, and Python.
* Experience with State\-Space Modeling, Control System Design, and Dynamic System Analysis.
* Knowledge of Attitude Determination \& Control Systems (ADCS) and Guidance, Navigation \& Control (GNC) principles.
* Understanding of Kalman Filtering, Extended Kalman Filters (EKF), and estimation techniques.
* Familiarity with Satellite Dynamics, Spacecraft Attitude Control, and Orbital Mechanics.
* Exposure to Embedded Systems and real\-time software development.
* Experience with simulation, verification, and validation methodologies.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem\-solving, and debugging skills.



  





  





**Preferred Qualifications (Optional):**




  




* Hands\-on experience with CubeSat, UAV, Robotics, Aerospace, or Space Engineering projects.
* Familiarity with Linux, Git, and software configuration management workflows.
* Exposure to embedded software or flight software development environments.
* Participation in university satellite programs, aerospace competitions, research projects, or space\-tech startups.
* Knowledge of spacecraft mission operations and satellite integration/testing activities.



  





  





**Why Join Azista Space?**




  




* Work on next\-generation satellite technologies and orbital missions.
* Be part of India’s first private\-sector satellite mass\-production ecosystem.
* Gain exposure to the complete spacecraft lifecycle—from design and simulation to testing and mission execution.
* Collaborate with industry\-leading engineers and innovators in the global space sector.
* Accelerate your career in one of the world’s fastest\-growing aerospace and space technology industries.

* Experience from Software domain.
* Exposure to multimedia development.
* Knowledge on CMS administration.
* Expert in information design and structured authoring.

* and other local benefits!

You may be just the right person for this or other roles.*

title: Business Analyst - AI
description:
**Your potential, unleashed.** 




  





 India’s impact on the global economy has increased at an exponential rate and Deloitte presents an opportunity to unleash and realize your potential amongst cutting edge leaders, and organizations shaping the future of the region, and indeed, the world beyond.
 



  





 At Deloitte, your whole self to work, every day. Combine that with our drive to propel with purpose and you have the perfect playground to collaborate, innovate, grow, and make an impact that matters.
 



  





**The team** 




  





 You’ll partner with Enabling Area / AI Team to unlock value from data and AI through modern analytics and GenAI capabilities (e.g., RAG, LLM integrations) and strong delivery practices.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**




 • Lead stakeholder interviews, workshops, and process walkthroughs to elicit and document functional/non\-functional requirements (BRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria).
 



 • Perform gap analysis, feasibility assessments, and traceability from business goals to product features.
 



 • Shape product vision and roadmap for AI features; prioritize backlogs based on value, feasibility, and risk.
 



 • Run Agile ceremonies (refinement, sprint planning, reviews) and maintain clear release plans and OKRs.
 



 • Translate use cases into LLM/GenAI solutions (e.g., retrieval\-augmented generation, prompt engineering, evaluation criteria) with DS/ML engineers.
 



 • Coordinate data availability, model monitoring, and governance (security, privacy, cost/performance) with platform teams.
 



 • Demo increments, validate requirements, and manage UAT with business users; drive adoption and training assets (playbooks, guides).
 



 • Communicate status, risks, and mitigation plans to leadership; support post\-launch analysis and continuous improvement.
 



 • Maintain clear artefacts (journey maps, process flows, personas, wireframes) and QA/test plans in partnership with QA leads.
 



  





**Qualifications**




 • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Technology, or Business; MBA is a plus.
 



 • Experience: Typically, 3–5 years in Product/BA roles.
 



 • Core: Proven requirements management, backlog ownership, and Agile delivery with enterprise stakeholders.
 



  





**Skills (Must\-have)**




 • Strong BA toolkit (elicitation, analysis, documentation, UAT).
 



 • Product tools (Jira/ADO/Confluence), and proficiency in MS Office for analysis and communication.
 



 • AI literacy: familiarity with LLMs/GenAI concepts, RAG patterns, evaluation/guardrails, and data governance.
 



 • Collaboration across Data Science, Engineering, UX; excellent stakeholder communication.
 



  





**Preferred Exposure**




 • Hands\-on with prompt design, GenAI evaluation, vector databases, or model lifecycle (training, deployment, monitoring).
 



 • Experience in cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP) and modern data/ML tooling.
 



  





**Success Metrics (KPIs)**




 • Requirement lead time (from intake to signed\-off user stories), backlog health, and sprint goal attainment.
 



 • Feature adoption (usage, satisfaction), model performance \& cost (for AI features), and defect escape rate/UAT pass\-rate.
 



  





**Working Model**




 Hybrid, with flexibility for stakeholder workshops, demos, and UAT at office/client sites as needed.
 



  





**How you’ll grow** 




  





***Connect for impact***




  





 Our exceptional team of professionals across the globe are solving some of the world’s most complex business problems, as well as directly supporting our communities, the planet, and each other. Know more in our Global Impact Report and our India Impact Report.
 








***Empower to lead***




  





 You can be a leader irrespective of your career level. Our colleagues are characterised by their ability to inspire, support, and provide opportunities for people to deliver their best and grow both as professionals and human beings. Know more about Deloitte and our One Young World partnership.
 








***Inclusion for all***




  





 At Deloitte, people are valued and respected for who they are and are trusted to add value to their clients, teams and communities in a way that reflects their own unique capabilities. Know more about everyday steps that you can take to be more inclusive. At Deloitte, we believe in the unique skills, attitude and potential each and every one of us brings to the table to make an impact that matters.
 



  





***Drive your career***




  





 At Deloitte, you are encouraged to take ownership of your career. We recognise there is no one size fits all career path, and global, cross\-business mobility and up / re\-skilling are all within the range of possibilities to shape a unique and fulfilling career. Know more about Life at Deloitte.
 



  





**Everyone’s welcome… entrust your happiness to us** 




  





 Our workspaces and initiatives are geared towards your 360\-degree happiness. This includes specific needs you may have in terms of accessibility, flexibility, safety and security, and caregiving. Here’s a glimpse of things that are in store for you.
 



  





**Interview tips** 




  





 We want job seekers exploring opportunities at Deloitte to feel prepared, confident and comfortable. title: Junior Consultant
description:
At Red Hat, we are open. Learn more about how our commitment to open source principles drives us to create better technology in community with others. We are the world's leading provider of enterprise open source solutions, using a community\-powered approach to deliver high\-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies.
   

  

 As part of the customer delivery team in New Delhi, a Junior Consultant at Red Hat is a technical person who supports the on\-site delivery, implementation, and adoption of Red Hat technology. These projects span various industries as we partner with customers to build enterprise IT solutions based on Red Hat platforms, which provide a trusted, consistent, and comprehensive foundation for any enterprise.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 As a Junior Consultant in
 **New Delhi,** 
 you’ll participate in the FASTER Program, a comprehensive 12\-month program designed to provide you with the deep technical knowledge, customer engagement skills needed to excel. You'll gain hands\-on experience with Red Hat's portfolio, learn from seasoned experts, and contribute to real\-world customer solutions from day one. This cohort\-based program starts on
 **1 September 2026\.**
**Through This Experience, You Will**
* Discover all about Red Hat and how we support our customers in addressing their technical, developmental, and strategic business challenges with our comprehensive portfolio and services.
* Develop technical skills in the Red Hat portfolio that span Cloud, Automation, and AI solutions by completing training programs and attaining certifications.
* Apply your technical skills as you engage in meaningful customer projects, experiences, and job shadowing opportunities.
* Assist more experienced members of the Services Delivery team as they support the on\-site delivery, implementation, and adoption of Red Hat technology
* Enhance your professional capabilities through real\-world experiences working directly with customers and participating in skill development opportunities.
* Gain an understanding of the processes and tools associated with enterprise\-level solution architecture.
* Support the Sales organizations’ goals to deliver customer business value, building enterprise IT solutions based on Red Hat platforms that create a trusted, consistent, and comprehensive foundation for any enterprise


 W
 **hat you will bring**
* Passion and curiosity for open source technology, desire to build a career within the Tech industry
* Strong technical skills in computer science, IT, AI, or related fields, gained through university programs, upskilling boot camps, certifications
* Demonstrated experience applying technical, analytical, and problem\-solving skills in an Enterprise IT\-related project
* Motivation to engage in self\-directed learning on new technologies
* Desire to be customer\-focused, understanding customer needs, and helping them achieve their goals
* Willingness to travel regularly to customer sites for project work and to local Red Hat offices to engage other Red Hat associates
* Effective communication (written and verbal) skills
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively with internal teams and external customers
* Experience in using Linux is preferred
* Nice to have one or more Red Hat certifications.
* Direct experience with any of Red Hat products, Red Hat Enterprise Linux, Red Hat OpenShift, Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform, Red Hat AI platform, and related technologies is a plus.


 Why Red Hat?
   

  

* Unparalleled Onboarding and Development: Set yourself up for long\-term success through our structured 12\-month program, which provides you with dedicated mentorship, hands\-on labs, certifications, and exposure to a wide range of technologies.
* Impactful Work: Contribute to solutions that empower businesses worldwide and shape the future of open source.
* Open Culture: Work in a collaborative environment where your ideas are valued and respected.


**About Red Hat**
 Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community\-powered approach to deliver high\-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40\+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in\-office, to office\-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.
   

  

**Inclusion at Red Hat**
 Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)**
 Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.
   

  

 Red Hat does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or CVs from recruitment agencies. We are not responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions, or any other payment related to unsolicited resumes or CVs except as required in a written contract between Red Hat and the recruitment agency or party requesting payment of a fee.
   

  

 Red Hat supports individuals with disabilities and provides reasonable accommodations to job applicants. If you need assistance completing our online job application, email application\-assistance@redhat.com. General inquiries, such as those regarding the status of a job application, will not receive a reply.

**About The Role**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks through profiling, benchmarking, and tuning
* Own production issues end\-to\-end, including root cause analysis and long\-term fixes
* Collaborate with control plane, SRE, and infrastructure \& hardware engineering teams to ensure system reliability
* Review designs and code, providing technical mentorship and guidance

* Be oncall

**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience

* Strong expertise in Linux operating systems, distributed systems, and systems programming
* Proven experience developing production\-grade systems in C\+\+ or Go
* Deep understanding of concurrency, memory management, and performance optimization
* Strong debugging skills in complex, large\-scale Linux environments \& Kubernetes.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Hands\-on experience with large\-scale storage systems (block, file, or object storage)
* Knowledge of storage technologies such as NVMe, SSDs, replication, sharding, and caching
* Experience building or operating distributed systems at cloud scale
* Familiarity with failure modes, resiliency patterns, and observability in storage systems
* Experience mentoring engineers and leading technical initiatives


**What We Offer**
* Ownership of critical storage infrastructure components
* Opportunity to influence architecture and long\-term technical direction
* Collaborative environment with high technical standards
* Competitive compensation and benefits

o *Call HK to bring the luggage down and check mini bar/any valuables left in the room*

o *Ask about the guests stay and feedbacks*

o *Ask about mini bar consumption to match with HK and post accordingly*

o *Print the bill and explain it to the guest*

o *Takepayment*

o *Help the guest with luggage/taxi…*

o *“Goodbye” at the door if possible*

**Job Type:** Full\-time, Permanent, Remote **Salary:** ₹20,000 – ₹25,000 per month **Hours:** 10:30 PM – 7:30 AM IST **Days:** Mon – Sat (Sundays off)

We are a premium, future\-focused edtech platform driving the next generation of professionals in Digital Marketing, Tech Infrastructure, and Advanced Analytics. Our curriculum is built on AI integration, clean workflows, and high\-impact execution. We move fast, value innovation, and expect excellence.

**The Role**

We are looking for a highly organized, tech\-forward **HR \& Talent Acquisition Intern** to help us build a world\-class team. You won't just be pushing paper; you will be the gatekeeper to our company culture. You will help us source top\-tier talent, streamline our hiring pipelines using modern tools, and ensure every new hire experiences a premium onboarding process.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* **Strategic Talent Sourcing:** Write compelling job descriptions and source candidates for key roles (Digital Marketing, Sales, and Tech) across platforms like LinkedIn and Internshala.
* **Modern Screening:** Conduct initial applicant screening and scheduling, utilizing modern Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) or AI\-assisted tools to filter for high\-quality talent.
* **The Onboarding Experience:** Coordinate the end\-to\-end onboarding workflow, ensuring new hires experience a seamless, professional, and welcoming introduction to the SkillSync ecosystem.
* **Culture \& Operations:** Assist in tracking team performance metrics, managing internal documentation, and brainstorming initiatives to keep our remote/hybrid team highly engaged.

**Who You Are**

* **Education:** Currently pursuing or recently graduated with a degree in HR, Business, or Management.
* **The "Premium" Mindset:** You understand the importance of employer branding and know how to communicate professionally and persuasively.
* **Tech\-Savvy \& Adaptable:** You are comfortable with Google Workspace, LinkedIn Recruiter (or similar tools), and are eager to leverage AI to make your HR workflows faster and smarter.
* **Detail\-Obsessed:** You don't let emails slip through the cracks, and you handle candidate data with complete confidentiality.

**Why Join Us?**

* **Build From the Ground Up:** Get hands\-on experience scaling a modern edtech startup.
* **Next\-Gen Skills:** Learn how HR operates in an AI\-driven, fast\-paced environment.
* **Career Trajectory:** Exceptional interns will be considered for a full\-time Pre\-Placement Offer (PPO).

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Talent Acquisition Intern
description:
***Company Description***

Hare and Turtle AI Solutions (HNT) is an AI solutions company that helps organizations design, build, and scale practical AI systems with confidence. We combine rapid experimentation with enterprise\-grade engineering to ensure AI initiatives deliver real business value without creating long\-term technical or operational risk. Our teams work across the full AI lifecycle, from problem framing and prototyping to production deployment and governance, enabling clients to move fast where it matters and build responsibly where it counts. At HNT, we focus on turning AI ambition into reliable, scalable outcomes.

***Role Description***

We are seeking a motivated and results\-driven US Technical Recruiter to join our Talent Acquisition team. The ideal candidate will have experience recruiting for the US market, with a strong understanding of technical hiring processes and sourcing strategies. This role requires expertise in identifying, engaging, and hiring top technology talent across various domains while ensuring an exceptional candidate experience throughout the recruitment lifecycle.

***Job Location:*** Pune, India.

***Experience:*** Fresher to 1 Year

***Key Responsibilities:***

* **Manage end\-to\-end recruitment for US\-based IT and technical positions.**
* Source, screen, and shortlist candidates for contract, contract\-to\-hire, and full\-time opportunities.
* **Utilize recruitment platforms such as LinkedIn Recruiter, Dice, Indeed, Monster, CareerBuilder, and other sourcing channels.**
* Understand and recruit for various technologies including Software Development, Data Engineering, Cloud, AI/ML, Cybersecurity, DevOps, QA, and Infrastructure roles.
* **Conduct initial candidate screening and evaluate technical qualifications, communication skills, work authorization status, and cultural fit.**
* Coordinate interviews between candidates, hiring managers, and clients.
* **Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified candidates for current and future hiring needs.**
* Maintain accurate candidate records, recruitment trackers, and ATS databases.
* **Follow up with candidates throughout the hiring process, including interview scheduling, feedback collection, and offer management.**
* Ensure compliance with US hiring practices and documentation requirements.
* **Meet recruitment targets, turnaround times, and client expectations.**
* Deliver a positive candidate experience while representing the company professionally.

***Required Skills:***

* **Basic understanding of US recruitment processes and staffing lifecycle.**
* Knowledge of US work authorization categories such as US Citizens, Green Card Holders, H\-1B, OPT/CPT, EAD, and TN Visa holders.
* **Familiarity with technical roles and emerging technologies.**
* Hands\-on experience using sourcing platforms such as LinkedIn, Dice, Indeed, Monster, and other job boards.
* **Strong resume screening and candidate evaluation skills.**
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* **Ability to work in a fast\-paced, target\-driven environment.**
* Strong organizational, coordination, and multitasking abilities.
* **Good negotiation and relationship\-building skills.**

***Qualification:***

* MBA in Human Resources / PGDM in HR (Mandatory)
* Bachelor's degree in any discipline

***Preferred Candidate:***

* **Profile**  Passionate about talent acquisition and technical recruiting.
* **Quick learner with a proactive and result\-oriented mindset.**
* Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills.
* **Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team.**
* Willingness to work in US shift timings.
* **Prior internship or training experience in US staffing/recruitment will be an added advantage.**

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

**About Us:**
=============


Itvedant was started with the aim of bridging the gap between education and skills needed for the job with an intense passion for teaching. We are looking for dynamic and passionate people from the software industry to be a part of our family who can lead the team of students towards a bright future.


**JOB INTRODUCTION:**


A Career Guide supports individuals in making informed career choices by offering personalized advice on career paths, skill development, and job market trends. They assess clients' strengths and interests to recommend suitable career options and educational programs. Career Guides work with students, graduates, and professionals seeking career growth or change. Strong counseling and communication skills are key to helping clients achieve their career goals.Responsible for end to end student admission cycle.


**ROLES \& RESPONSIBILITIES:**  

* Evaluates student recruitment techniques by determining the effectiveness of each recruitment technique.
  
* Welcomes prospective students by processing paperwork; interviewing applicants; conducting follow\-up activities such as emails and phone\-calling campaigns.
  
* Handling of student enquiries effectively.
  
* Explaining the candidate about the available IT courses and its payment plans and resolving their doubts and queries accordingly.
  
* Following up with the candidate for joining the course/ programme and for the payment.
  
* Making follow up calls for due payments from the candidates.
  
* Timely updation and scheduling of upcoming batches to all the concerned team members, trainers and students.
  
* Achieving targets set by the Branch Manager.
  
* Maintain a MIS of the students who have taken admissions or have done enquiries
  
* Develops a healthy alumni network and arranges for student interactive sessions.
  
* Maintains recruiting operations by following policies and procedures; reporting needed changes.
  
* Enhances admissions department and institute reputation by accepting ownership for accomplishing new and different requests for admissions.
  
* Any other work allotted by the management.
  

**JOB QUALIFICATION \& SKILL SETS:**  

* A bachelor’s degree in psychology, counseling, human resources, education, or a related field. A master’s degree or certifications in career counseling is a plus.
  
* Experience in career counseling, coaching, HR, or a related field is often preferred.
  
* Certifications in career guidance or coaching (e.g., Certified Career Counselor) can be beneficial.
  
* Excellent verbal and written communication to provide clear guidance and support.
  
* Ability to present services effectively, address client concerns, and encourage commitment to career guidance programs.
  

**Perks \& Benefits :**  

* Attractive Incentive
  
* 12 Holidays and 21 leaves for the year
  
* Monthly, Quarterly \& Yearly Recognition
  
* Medical Insurance along with the family covered
  
* OPD facility along with the family covered
  
* Chance to win Indian \& International trips
  
* Career Growth Enhancement
  
* Continuous training \& development

title: Hiring Manager
description:
A **hiring manager** is the department leader or supervisor who requests a new position, owns the talent pipeline for their specific team, and **holds the final authority to make the hiring decision**. Unlike full\-time HR professionals or internal recruiters who source candidates and manage corporate compliance, a hiring manager focuses on finding the right technical capability and cultural alignment to drive team productivity. \[1, 2, 3, 4, 5]The end\-to\-end roles and responsibilities of a hiring manager span five distinct phases of the talent acquisition lifecycle: \[1, 2]1\. Preparation and Role Definition

* **Identify Staffing Needs**: Assess current workloads to determine if a replacement or a brand\-new role is necessary to scale operations. \[1, 2]
* **Secure Requisition Approval**: Build the business case and negotiate salary budgets with senior executives or finance teams to get formal approval for the hire. \[1, 2]
* **Draft Job Descriptions**: Define required technical skills, daily responsibilities, mandatory qualifications, and key performance indicators (KPIs) in collaboration with HR. \[1, 2, 3]

2\. Recruitment Strategy and Sourcing

* **Align with the Recruiting Team**: Partner with internal recruiters to outline candidate profiles, establish realistic hiring timelines, and set up evaluation SLAs. \[1, 2]
* **Leverage Internal Networks**: Market the open position internally and proactively source talent via employee referral programs or professional industry networks. \[1, 2]
* **Refine Screening Filters**: Assist the talent acquisition team in optimizing applicant tracking system (ATS) filters and reviewing initial shortlists for highly specialized fields. \[1]

Pay: ₹180,000\.00 \- ₹200,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**Job Description: HR Manager** 




  





**Location:** 
 Dadar, Mumbai, India
 



**Department:** 
 HR
 



**Reports To:** 
 Management
 



  





**About Rynox** 




 Rynox is a fast\-growing retail brand with an ambitious expansion roadmap. We are building out our HR function from the ground up and we need someone who can own it.
 



  





 This is not a coordinator role. You will be the HR function. You will work directly with the Founder, lead a small team, and be responsible for everything from getting the right people in the door to making sure they are paid correctly, treated well, and set up to do their best work.
 



  





 If you want a role where you manage a process someone else designed, this is not it. If you want to build something and have the authority to do so, read on.
 



  





**WHAT WILL YOU OWN** 




**Recruitment:** 




 •   Partner with department heads to understand hiring needs and build pipelines that move fast
 



 •   Lead end\-to\-end recruitment across HQ and stores, from sourcing to offer closure
 



 •   Oversee and guide your executive on CV sourcing, candidate calling, and initial screening; you will review pipelines, coach on quality, and step in where needed
 



 •   Given the nature of retail, replacement hires must be closed within the notice period so that store operations are not impacted
 



 •   Negotiate offers, manage candidate experience, and ensure every new joiner has a strong first day
 



  





**HR Operations and Payroll:** 




 •   Run monthly payroll end\-to\-end, including inputs, processing, disbursement, and resolution of employee queries
 



 •   Manage all statutory compliance including PF and ESIC filings, on time, every time
 



 •   Own the employee lifecycle: onboarding, confirmations, transfers, exits, and Full and Final settlements
 



 •   Ensure all employee records, documentation, and compliance are always audit\-ready
 



  





**Employee Relations:** 




 •   Be the go\-to person for employees across HQ and all store locations for any HR\-related query or concern
 



 •   Handle salary and deduction queries with clarity and empathy
 



 •   Address grievances fairly and quickly; flag patterns to leadership with solutions
 



  





**Policy \& Process:** 




 •   Identify gaps in HR policy and build frameworks where none exist, covering leave, attendance, expenses, and more
 



 •   Get policies approved, communicate them clearly, and ensure they are followed
 



 •   Continuously improve processes to reduce manual effort and improve the employee experience
 



  





**Culture \& Engagement:** 




 •   Own the induction experience so every new joiner understands what Rynox stands for
 



 •   Create a culture of accountability and warmth, structured enough to scale and human enough to matter
 



 •   Drive small but meaningful engagement moments across the team
 



  





**Who We're Looking For:** 




 You have 3 to 6 years of HR experience, ideally in a retail or consumer brand. You have run payroll, handled compliance, hired at volume, and resolved the kind of messy people situations that do not come with a textbook answer.

description:

As an HR Technology Analyst, you will be responsible for supporting configuration requests and participating in projects. You will be a strategic business partner who applies technology to support business requirements.  

Demonstrating Workday expertise, the HR Technology team partners with HR Centers of Expertise and the HR community to answer functionality questions, resolve issues, work with vendors on system‑related concerns, and test new functionality. A key focus of this role is supporting and enhancing Workday Recruit, partnering closely with the Talent Acquisition CoE to design, configure, and optimize recruiting processes that improve system performance and the overall candidate experience. You will also support and manage day‑to‑day operations with Paradox and HiredScore to ensure smooth recruiter workflows and high‑quality candidate engagement.  

The Analyst will be involved in the deployment of new Workday features as well as operational improvements; this includes implementing new security roles, leading configuration changes, and executing end\-to\-end testing for Workday upgrades.

* Configure changes in Workday based on business requirements.

* Project team member/lead for the design and implementation of new Workday functionalities, including business process configuration, testing, interface and integration support, implementation through deployment, and postproduction support.
* Support processes within Workday, with a particular focus on recruiting workflows and TA related functionality.
* Develop strong relationships with internal partners, including the Talent Acquisition CoE, to gain an understanding of business requirements and translate them into effective system solutions.
* Create custom Workday reports as needed to meet business needs/objectives.
* Plan, coordinate, and implement testing efforts for changes within Workday, including recruiting related enhancements and integrations.
* Support the design, development, and performance of Workday and related business data and processes. Focus on identifying trends, resolving root causes, predicting future implications, and finding solutions to drive effective business decisions.
* Proactively identify and assist in prioritizing opportunities to streamline business and/or system processes, especially within the recruiting lifecycle.
* Lead biyearly Workday upgrades, including end\-to\-end testing of Workday Recruit functionality.
* Partner with the Talent Acquisition CoE to analyze and enhance the candidate journey, using Workday Recruit configuration and supporting technologies to streamline application flow and improve candidate experience.
* Oversee daily operations and optimization of Paradox and HiredScore, including troubleshooting issues, monitoring performance, driving adoption, and identifying enhancements that improve recruiter efficiency and candidate engagement.

* Degree in business or management information systems, HR (CIPD), or equivalent combination of education and experience.

* Customer service focus and flexibility in supporting business unit needs.
* Demonstrated competence in presenting concepts clearly and accurately with strong written and verbal interpersonal skills. Able to positively represent Johnson Controls and communicate with others at varying managerial and technical levels.
* Commitment to quality and continuous improvement.
* History of significant customer satisfaction, building rapport, and influencing decisions while working in a consultative role with customers.
 **Preferred**  

We’d ideally love you to have experience as a contributing team member within HR operational projects and new implementations, including the full change request lifecycle (solution design, configuration, testing, communication, etc.). An overall understanding of HR data, HR processes, and the change/implementation life cycle is important.  

Workday experience is highly desirable, particularly in configuring and supporting:  

* Workday Recruit (job requisitions, job postings, candidate stages, screening steps, offer workflows, and recruiting related security)
* Payroll
* Compensation

* Reporting
