Job Title: HR Executive

**Location:** Ahmedabad  
**Experience:** 3–4 Years

**About the Role**

We are seeking a proactive and people\-centric HR Executive to join our growing team. The ideal candidate will have prior experience in the IT industry and will be responsible for managing end\-to\-end recruitment, HR operations, employee engagement, and fostering a positive workplace culture. The candidate should possess strong interpersonal skills, hands\-on experience with HRMS tools, and the ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment.

**Key ResponsibilitiesTalent Acquisition \& Recruitment**

* Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, and onboarding candidates.
* Handle end\-to\-end IT recruitment for technical and non\-technical positions.
* Coordinate with hiring managers to understand manpower requirements and job specifications.
* Source candidates through job portals, social media, employee referrals, and professional networks.
* Schedule and coordinate interviews, provide timely feedback, and ensure a smooth candidate experience.
* Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline for current and future hiring needs.

**HR Operations**

* Manage employee onboarding and offboarding processes.
* Maintain and update employee records, HR documentation, and personnel files.
* Administer attendance, leave management, and employee data through HRMS platforms.
* Generate HR reports and maintain accurate HR databases.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and statutory requirements.

**Employee Engagement \& Cultur**e

* Plan and execute employee engagement activities, events, and celebrations.
* Conduct employee induction and orientation programs.
* Support initiatives related to employee well\-being, recognition, and retention.
* Foster a positive, inclusive, and collaborative work environment.

**Performance Management \& Employee Relations**

* Assist in the performance appraisal and feedback process.
* Address employee concerns and provide HR support to employees and managers.
* Ensure effective implementation of HR policies and processes across the organization.
* Act as a bridge between management and employees to maintain healthy employee relations.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 3–4 years of relevant HR experience, preferably in the IT industry.
* Proven experience in end\-to\-end IT recruitment.
* Strong understanding of HR operations and employee lifecycle management.
* Hands\-on experience with HRMS tools such as **greytHR** or similar platforms.
* Experience working with project management and collaboration tools such as **Jira**, **Confluence**, or similar software.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong organizational, multitasking, and problem\-solving abilities.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
* Ability to work independently and effectively in a dynamic environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of Indian labor laws and statutory compliance.
* Experience in employer branding and employee engagement initiatives.
* Familiarity with HR analytics and reporting.
* Prior experience in a technology services or product\-based organization will be an added advantage.

**Why Join Us?**

* Opportunity to work in a fast\-growing and innovative organization.
* Collaborative and employee\-friendly work culture.
* Exposure to diverse HR functions and strategic initiatives.
* Continuous learning and professional growth opportunities.

Pay: From ₹30,000\.00 per month

**Job Description: HR cum Talent Hiring Manager.
 



 Company: Walkfin Financing Services Pvt. Ltd.
 



 Location: Pune, Maharashtra
 



 Department: Human Resources
 



 Employment Type: Full\-time
 



 Reports To: Head of HR / COO.
 



  





 About Walkfin Financing Services Pvt. Ltd.
 



 Walkfin Financing Services Pvt. Ltd. is a new age fintech company offering quick, hassle\-free, and
 



 safe lending solutions to MSMEs. The company provides business loans and invoice discounting
 



 through fully digital, paperless processes, enabling businesses to access credit seamlessly and
 



 efficiently.
 



  





 Website: https://walkfin.com
 



  





 Address: NSG Building, Wadgaon Narhe Road, Pune\-411046, Maharashtra, India
 



  





 Role Overview
 



 The HR cum Talent Hiring Manager will lead end\-to\-end recruitment, onboarding, HR operations,
 



 employee engagement, and compliance functions. The role requires balancing strong hiring
 



 capabilities with efficient HR management to build a high\-performing workforce within a fast\-paced
 



 fintech environment/ Financial Services .
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. Talent Acquisition \& Recruitment Management
 



 • Manage the full recruitment lifecycle: job posting, sourcing, screening, assessments,
 



 interviews, salary negotiations, and offer rollout.
 



 • Partner with department heads to understand manpower needs and ensure timely hiring
 



 closures.
 



 • Design and implement sourcing strategies for niche roles in fintech, operations, credit,
 



 collections, and technology.
 



 • Maintain recruitment dashboards, trackers, and MIS reports.
 



 • Build and maintain a pipeline of high\-quality candidates through networking, job portals,
 



 social platforms, and referrals.
 



  





 2\. Campus Hiring
 



 • Plan and lead campus hiring initiatives for entry\-level and trainee positions.
 



 • Connect with colleges, manage placement drives, internship programs, and build long\-term
 



 campus relationships.
 



 • Conduct pre\-placement talks, tests, group discussions, and interviews.
 



 • Ensure excellent student engagement and employer branding at campuses.
 



  





 3\. Onboarding \& Induction
 



 • Coordinate end\-to\-end onboarding: documentation, background verification, induction
 



 planning, and joining formalities.
 



 • Conduct structured induction sessions and ensure smooth assimilation of new hires.
 



 • Monitor early employee experience and collect feedback for improvement.
 



  





 4\. Employee Relations \& Engagement
 



 • Serve as the primary point of contact for employee queries and workplace support.
 



 • Facilitate conflict resolution, grievance handling, and performance\-related discussions.
 



 • Contribute to building a positive and transparent work culture aligned with company values.
 



 • Organize engagement activities, employee events, and internal communication initiatives.
 



  





 5\. HR Administration \& Compliance
 



 • Maintain up\-to\-date employee records in the HR system.
 



 • Ensure adherence to company policies, statutory compliance, and audit requirements.
 



 • Support HR documentation, letters, and policy implementation.
 



 • Assist in labour compliance coordination and reporting.
 



  





 6\. Compensation \& Benefits Support
 



 • Assist employees with compensation structure clarifications and benefits\-related queries.
 



 • Coordinate with payroll teams to ensure accurate salary inputs and timely processing.
 



 • Manage benefits administration including leaves, reimbursements, and statutory benefits.
 



  





 7\. Training \& Development
 



 • Support in identifying skill gaps and training needs across teams.
 



 • Plan and coordinate training programs, workshops, and learning initiatives.
 



 • Track employee training completion and maintain learning records.
 



  





 8\. HR Reporting \& Process Improvements
 



 • Prepare periodic HR reports: headcount, attrition, hiring status, joining pipeline, etc.
 



 • Participate in HR projects such as policy updates, digitization initiatives, and process
 



 improvements.
 



 • Contribute to building efficient HR workflows, automation, and documentation standards.
 



  





  





 Qualifications \& Skills Required
 



 Educational Qualification
 



 • Bachelor’s Degree in HR, Business Administration, or related field (MBA/PGDM preferred).
 



  





 Experience
 



 • 3–5 years of experience in HR and Talent Acquisition, preferably within
 



 Fintech/NBFC/Financial Services.
 



 • Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
 



 • Strong understanding of recruitment processes and HR operations.
 



  





 Core Competencies
 



 • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
 



 • Strong stakeholder management and problem\-solving ability.
 



 • Ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast\-paced environment.
 



 • High levels of integrity, confidentiality, and organizational skills.
 



  





 Why Join Walkfin
 



 • Opportunity to contribute to a fast\-growing digital lending organization.
 



 • Exposure to multiple HR domains and key business functions.
 



 • Dynamic, innovative, and collaborative work culture.
 



 • Direct impact on talent building and organizational growth**
